body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ أَسْفِرُوا بِالْفَجْرِ

h2_title_en: Al-Isfar (Praying fajr When It Has Become Lighter)
title: null
chain_en: Ibrāhīm b. Yaʿqūb > Ibn Abū Maryam > Abū Ghassān > Zayd b. Aslam > ʿĀṣim b. ʿUmar b. Qatādah > Maḥmūd b. Labīd > Rijāl from Qawmih from al-Anṣār
body_en: The more you delay Fajr, the greater the reward.
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ أَسْلَمَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ عَنْ رِجَالٍ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مَا أَسْفَرْتُمْ بِالْفَجْرِ فَإِنَّهُ أَعْظَمُ بِالأَجْرِ

h2_title_en: Whoever Catches Up With A Rak'ah Of The Subh Prayer
h2_title: باب مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ
title: null
chain_en: Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad And Muḥammad b. al-Muthanná > Yaḥyá > ʿAbdullāh b. Saʿīd > ʿAbd al-Raḥman al-Aʿraj > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: Whoever catches up with a prostration of Subh before the sun rises, then he has caught up with it; and whoever catches up with a prostration of 'Asr before the sun sets, then he has caught up with it.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ سَجْدَةً مِنَ الصُّبْحِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا وَمَنْ أَدْرَكَ سَجْدَةً مِنَ الْعَصْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا

h2_title_en: Whoever Catches Up With A Rak'ah Of The Subh Prayer
h2_title: باب مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Rāfiʿ > Zakariyyā b. ʿAdī > Ibn al-Mubārak > Yūnus b. Yazīd > al-Zuhrī > ʿUrwah > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: Whoever catches up with a Rak'ah of Fajr before the sun rises, then he has caught up with it; and whoever catches up with a Rak'ah of 'Asr before the sun sets, then he has caught up with it.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ عَدِيٍّ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الْفَجْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا وَمَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الْعَصْرِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا

h2_title_en: The End Of The Time For Subh
title: null
chain_en: Ismāʿīl b. Masʿūd And Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlá > Khālid > Shuʿbah > Abū Ṣadaqah > Anas b. Mālik
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray Zuhr when the sun passed its zenith, and he would pray 'Asr between these two prayers; and he would pray Maghrib when the sun had set, and he used to pray 'Isha' when the twilight had disappeared," then he said straight after that: "And he would pray Fajr when a man could see clearly.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي صَدَقَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ
body: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ إِذَا زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَيُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ بَيْنَ صَلاَتَيْكُمْ هَاتَيْنِ وَيُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ إِذَا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَيُصَلِّي الْعِشَاءَ إِذَا غَابَ الشَّفَقُ ثُمَّ قَالَ عَلَى إِثْرِهِ وَيُصَلِّي الصُّبْحَ إِلَى أَنْ يَنْفَسِحَ الْبَصَرُ

h2_title_en: Whoever Catches Up With A Rak'ah Of The Prayer
h2_title: باب مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Mālik > Ibn Shihāb > Abū Salamah > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: Whoever catches up with a Rak'ah of the prayer, then he has caught up with the prayer.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ رَكْعَةً فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الصَّلاَةَ

h2_title_en: Whoever Catches Up With A Rak'ah Of The Prayer
h2_title: باب مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > ʿAbdullāh b. Idrīs > ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿUmar > al-Zuhrī > Abū Salamah > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: Whoever catches up with a Rak'ah of the prayer, then he has caught up with it.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ رَكْعَةً فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا

h2_title_en: Whoever Catches Up With A Rak'ah Of The Prayer
h2_title: باب مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Yazīd b. Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Ṣamad > Hishām al-ʿAṭṭār > Ismāʿīl / Ibn Samāʿah > Mūsá b. Aʿyan > Abū ʿAmr al-Awzāʿī > al-Zuhrī > Abū Salamah > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: Whoever catches up with a Rak'ah of the prayer, then he has caught up with the prayer.
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ الْعَطَّارُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَعْيَنَ عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو الأَوْزَاعِيِّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ رَكْعَةً فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الصَّلاَةَ

h2_title_en: Whoever Catches Up With A Rak'ah Of The Prayer
h2_title: باب مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Shuʿayb b. Shuʿayb b. Isḥāq > Abū al-Mughīrah > al-Awzāʿī > al-Zuhrī > Saʿīd b. al-Musayyab > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever catches up with a Rak'ah of the prayer has caught up with it.
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي شُعَيْبُ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ رَكْعَةً فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا

h2_title_en: Whoever Catches Up With A Rak'ah Of The Prayer
h2_title: باب مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Mūsá b. Sulaymān b. Ismāʿīl b. al-Qāsim > Baqiyyah > Yūnus > al-Zuhrī > Sālim from his father
body_en: Whoever catches up with with a Rak'ah of Jumu'ah or any other (prayer), his prayer is complete.
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ عَنْ يُونُسَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
body: عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الْجُمُعَةِ أَوْ غَيْرِهَا فَقَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ

h2_title_en: Whoever Catches Up With A Rak'ah Of The Prayer
h2_title: باب مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl al-Tirmidhī > Ayyūb b. Sulaymān > Abū Bakr > Sulaymān b. Bilāl > Yūnus > Ibn Shihāb > Sālim
body_en: Whoever catches up with a Rak'ah of one of the prayers has caught up with it, except that he has to make up the portion that he missed.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ التِّرْمِذِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلاَةٍ مِنَ الصَّلَوَاتِ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَهَا إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ

h2_title_en: Times During Which Salah Is Prohibited
h2_title: باب السَّاعَاتِ الَّتِي نُهِيَ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Mālik > Zayd b. Aslam > ʿAṭāʾ b. Yasār > ʿAbdullāh al-Ṣunābiḥī
body_en:
The sun rises and with it the horn of the Shaitan, then when it is fully risen, he goes away. Then when it approaches the meridian he comes near to it, and when it has passed the zenith he goes away. Then when it is close to setting, he comes near to it, then when it has set, he goes away." h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying After Subh
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Mālik > Muḥammad b. Yaḥyá b. Ḥibbān > al-Aʿraj > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: It was narrated from Abu Hurairah that the Prophet ﷺ forbade praying after 'Asr until the sun had set, and after Subh until the sun had risen.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حِبَّانَ عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ وَعَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ

h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying After Subh
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ
title: null
chain_en: Aḥmad b. Manīʿ > Hushaym > Manṣūr > Qatādah > Abū al-ʿĀliyah > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: I heard more than one of the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ - including 'Umar who was one of the dearest of them to me - that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade praying after Fajr until the sun had risen, and praying after 'Asr until the sun had set.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا مَنْصُورٌ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْعَالِيَةِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: سَمِعْتُ غَيْرَ وَاحِدٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِنْهُمْ عُمَرُ وَكَانَ مِنْ أَحَبِّهِمْ إِلَىَّ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ وَعَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ

h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying While The Sun Is Rising
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah b. Saʿīd > Mālik > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: No one of you should deliberately try to pray when the sun is rising, or when it is setting.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لاَ يَتَحَرَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فَيُصَلِّيَ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَعِنْدَ غُرُوبِهَا

h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying While The Sun Is Rising
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ
title: null
chain_en: Ismāʿīl b. Masʿūd > Khālid > ʿUbaydullāh > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade praying when the sun is rising or setting.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ أَنْبَأَنَا خَالِدٌ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَهَى أَنْ يُصَلَّى مَعَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ أَوْ غُرُوبِهَا

h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying At Midday
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ نِصْفَ النَّهَارِ
title: null
chain_en: Ḥumayd b. Masʿadah > Sufyān / Ibn Ḥabīb > Mūsá b. ʿUla from his father > ʿUqbah b. ʿĀmir
body_en: I heard 'Uqbah bin 'Amir say: 'There are three times during which the Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade us from praying or burying our dead: When the sun had clearly started to rise until it was fully risen, when it was directly overhead at noon until it has passed the zenith, and when it was close to setting until it had fully set.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ وَهُوَ ابْنُ حَبِيبٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُلَىٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ
body: سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ يَقُولُ ثَلاَثُ سَاعَاتٍ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَنْهَانَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ فِيهِنَّ أَوْ نَقْبُرَ فِيهِنَّ مَوْتَانَا حِينَ تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ بَازِغَةً حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ وَحِينَ يَقُومُ قَائِمُ الظَّهِيرَةِ حَتَّى تَمِيلَ وَحِينَ تَضَيَّفُ لِلْغُرُوبِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ

h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying After 'Asr
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: Mujāhid b. Mūsá > Ibn ʿUyaynah > Ḍamrah b. Saʿīd > Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ forbade praying after Subh until the sun had risen, and praying after 'Asr until the sun had set.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُجَاهِدُ بْنُ مُوسَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ ضَمْرَةَ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ
body: سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى الطُّلُوعِ وَعَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى الْغُرُوبِ

h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying After 'Asr
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd b. Muḥammad > Makhlad > Ibn Jurayj > Ibn Shihāb > ʿAṭāʾ b. Yazīd > Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
body_en: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'There is no prayer after Fajr until the sun has clearly risen, and no prayer after 'Asr until the sun has fully set.'
chain: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَخْلَدٌ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ يَقُولُ
body: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ لاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ الْفَجْرِ حَتَّى تَبْزُغَ الشَّمْسُ وَلاَ صَلاَةَ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ الشَّمْسُ

h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying After 'Asr
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: Maḥmūd b. Ghaylān > al-Walīd > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Namir > Ibn Shihāb > ʿAṭāʾ b. Yazīd > Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī
body_en: (Another chain) from Abu Sa'eed Al-Khudri, from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a similar report.
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ نَمِرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ
body: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِنَحْوِهِ

h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying After 'Asr
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: Aḥmad b. Ḥarb > Sufyān > Hishām b. Ḥujayr > Ṭāwus > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that the Prophet ﷺ forbade praying after 'Asr.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حُجَيْرٍ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ نَهَى عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ

h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying After 'Asr
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Mubārak al-Mukharrimī > al-Faḍl b. > Basah > Wuhayb > Ibn Ṭāwus from his father > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: 'Aishah, may Allah be please with her, said: 'Umar, may Allah be please with him, is not correct, rather the Messenger of Allah ﷺ only prohibited, as he said: 'Do no deliberately seek to pray when the sun is rising or when it is setting, for it rises between the horns of a Shaitan.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ الْمُخَرِّمِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَنْبَسَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ قَالَتْ
body: عَائِشَةُ ؓ أَوْهَمَ عُمَرُ ؓ إِنَّمَا نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ لاَ تَتَحَرَّوْا بِصَلاَتِكُمْ طُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ وَلاَ غُرُوبَهَا فَإِنَّهَا تَطْلُعُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَىْ شَيْطَانٍ

h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying After 'Asr
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿAlī > Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd > Hishām b. ʿUrwah from my father > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When the edge of the sun rises, then delay prayer until it has fully risen, and when the edge of the sun starts to set, delay prayer until it has fully set.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ عُمَرَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا طَلَعَ حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ فَأَخِّرُوا الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى تُشْرِقَ وَإِذَا غَابَ حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ فَأَخِّرُوا الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى تَغْرُبَ

h2_title_en: The Prohibition Of Praying After 'Asr
h2_title: باب النَّهْىِ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAmr b. Manṣūr > Ādam b. Abū Iyās > al-Layth b. Saʿd > Muʿāwiyah b. Ṣāliḥ > Abū Yaḥyá Sulaym b. ʿĀmir And Ḍamrah b. Ḥabīb Waʾabū Ṭalḥah Nuʿaym b. Ziyād > Abū Umāmah al-Bāhilī > ʿAmr b. ʿAbasah
body_en: We heard Abu Umamah Al-Bahili say: 'I heard 'Amrah bin 'Abasah say: I said: 'O Messenger of Allah, is there any moment which brings one close to Allah than another, or any moment that should be sought out for remembering Allah? He said: 'Yes, the closest that the Lord is to His slave is in the last part of the night, so if you can be among those who remember Allah at that time, then do so. For prayer is attended and witnessed (by the angels) until the sun rises, then it rises between the two horns of the Shaitan, that is the time when the disbelievers pray, so do not pray until the sun had risen to the height of a spear and its rays have disappeared. Then prayer is attended and witness (by the angels) until the sun is directly overhead at midday, and that is the time when the gates of Hell are opened and it is stoked up. So do not pray until the shadows appear. Then prayer is attended and witnessed (by angels) until the sun sets, and it sets between the horns of a Shaitan, and that is the time when the disbelievers pray.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو يَحْيَى سُلَيْمُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ وَضَمْرَةُ بْنُ حَبِيبٍ وَأَبُو طَلْحَةَ نُعَيْمُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ قَالُوا سَمِعْنَا أَبَا أُمَامَةَ الْبَاهِلِيَّ يَقُولُ
body: سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ عَبَسَةَ يَقُولُ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَلْ مِنْ سَاعَةٍ أَقْرَبُ مِنَ الأُخْرَى أَوْ هَلْ مِنْ سَاعَةٍ يُبْتَغَى ذِكْرُهَا قَالَ نَعَمْ إِنَّ أَقْرَبَ مَا يَكُونُ الرَّبُّ ﷻ مِنَ الْعَبْدِ جَوْفُ اللَّيْلِ الآخِرِ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ مِمَّنْ يَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ﷻ فِي تِلْكَ السَّاعَةِ فَكُنْ فَإِنَّ الصَّلاَةَ مَحْضُورَةٌ مَشْهُودَةٌ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ فَإِنَّهَا تَطْلُعُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَىِ الشَّيْطَانِ وَهِيَ سَاعَةُ صَلاَةِ الْكُفَّارِ فَدَعِ الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى تَرْتَفِعَ قِيدَ رُمْحٍ وَيَذْهَبَ شُعَاعُهَا ثُمَّ الصَّلاَةُ مَحْضُورَةٌ مَشْهُودَةٌ حَتَّى تَعْتَدِلَ الشَّمْسُ اعْتِدَالَ الرُّمْحِ بِنِصْفِ النَّهَارِ فَإِنَّهَا سَاعَةٌ تُفْتَحُ فِيهَا أَبْوَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَتُسْجَرُ فَدَعِ الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى يَفِيءَ الْفَىْءُ ثُمَّ الصَّلاَةُ مَحْضُورَةٌ مَشْهُودَةٌ حَتَّى تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ فَإِنَّهَا تَغِيبُ بَيْنَ قَرْنَىْ شَيْطَانٍ وَهِيَ صَلاَةُ الْكُفَّارِ

h2_title_en: Concession Allowing Prayer After 'Asr
h2_title: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > Jarīr > Manṣūr > Hilāl b. Yisāf > Wahbb. al-Ajdaʿ > ʿAlī
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺforbade praying after 'Asr unless the sun was still white, clear and high.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ يِسَافٍ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ الأَجْدَعِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ
body: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ الشَّمْسُ بَيْضَاءَ نَقِيَّةً مُرْتَفِعَةً

h2_title_en: Concession Allowing Prayer After 'Asr
h2_title: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. Saʿīd > Yaḥyá > Hishām from my father
body_en: My father told me: 'Aishah said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never neglected to pray two Rak'ahs after 'Asr in my house.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ هِشَامٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي قَالَ قَالَتْ
body: عَائِشَةُ مَا تَرَكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ عِنْدِي قَطُّ

h2_title_en: Concession Allowing Prayer After 'Asr
h2_title: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Qudāmah > Jarīr > Mughīrah > Ibrāhīm > al-Aswad
body_en: 'Aishah said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never entered upon me after 'Asr but he prayed them (the two Rak'ahs)."
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُدَامَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ قَالَ قَالَتْ
body: عَائِشَةُ ؓ ا مَا دَخَلَ عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ إِلاَّ صَلاَّهُمَا

h2_title_en: Concession Allowing Prayer After 'Asr
h2_title: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: Ismāʿīl b. Masʿūd > Khālid b. al-Ḥārith > Shuʿbah > Abū Isḥāq > Masrūq And al-Aswad > Nashhad > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: I heard Masruq and Al-Aswad say: We bear witness that 'Aishah said: 'When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was with me after 'Asr, he would pray them (these two Rak'ahs).'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ
body: سَمِعْتُ مَسْرُوقًا وَالأَسْوَدَ قَالاَ نَشْهَدُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا كَانَ عِنْدِي بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ صَلاَّهُمَا

h2_title_en: Concession Allowing Prayer After 'Asr
h2_title: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAlī b. Ḥujr > ʿAlī b. Mushir > Abū Isḥāq > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Aswad from his father > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: There are two prayers that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never neglected to pray them in my house secretly nor publicly: Two Rak'ahs before Fajr and two Rak'ahs after 'Asr.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: صَلاَتَانِ مَا تَرَكَهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي بَيْتِي سِرًّا وَلاَ عَلاَنِيَةً رَكْعَتَانِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ وَرَكْعَتَانِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ

h2_title_en: Concession Allowing Prayer After 'Asr
h2_title: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAlī b. Ḥujr > Ismāʿīl > Muḥammad b. Abū Ḥarmalah > Abū Salamah
body_en: He used to pray them before 'Asr, but if he got distracted or forgot them, he would pray them after 'Asr, and if he did a prayer he would be constant in it.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَرْمَلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ عَائِشَةَ
body: عَنِ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّيهِمَا بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ يُصَلِّيهِمَا قَبْلَ الْعَصْرِ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ شُغِلَ عَنْهُمَا أَوْ نَسِيَهُمَا فَصَلاَّهُمَا بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ وَكَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى صَلاَةً أَثْبَتَهَا

h2_title_en: Concession Allowing Prayer After 'Asr
h2_title: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlá > al-Muʿtamir > Maʿmar > Yaḥyá b. Abū Kathīr > Abū Salamah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman > Um Salamah
body_en: They are two Rak'ahs that I used to pray after Zuhr, but I got distracted and forgot them until I prayed 'Asr.
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَعْمَرًا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ صَلَّى فِي بَيْتِهَا بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَّهَا ذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ هُمَا رَكْعَتَانِ كُنْتُ أُصَلِّيهِمَا بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ فَشُغِلْتُ عَنْهُمَا حَتَّى صَلَّيْتُ الْعَصْرَ

h2_title_en: Concession Allowing Prayer After 'Asr
h2_title: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > Wakīʿ > Ṭalḥah b. Yaḥyá > ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUtbah > Um Salamah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ got distracted and did not pray the two Rak'ahs before 'Asr so he prayed them after 'Asr.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا وَكِيعٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ
body: شُغِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْعَصْرِ فَصَلاَّهُمَا بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ

h2_title_en: Concession Regarding Prayer Before The Sun Sets
h2_title: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿUthmān b. ʿAbdullāh > ʿUbaydullāh b. Muʿādh from my father > ʿImrān b. Ḥudayr > Saʾalt Lāḥiq > al-Rakʿatayn Qabl Ghurūb al-Shams
body_en: I asked Lahiq about the two Rak'ahs before sunset. He said: "Abdullah bin Az-Zubair used to pray them, and Mu'awiyah sent word to him asking: 'What are these two Rak'ahs at sunset?' He had to refer to Umm Salamah, and Umm Salamah said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to pray two Rak'ahs before 'Asr, then he was distracted and did not pray them, so he prayed them when the sun set, and I never saw him pray them before or after that.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبِي قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ حُدَيْرٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ لاَحِقًا عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ فَقَالَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ يُصَلِّيهِمَا فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ مُعَاوِيَةُ مَا هَاتَانِ الرَّكْعَتَانِ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ فَاضْطَرَّ الْحَدِيثَ إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ فَقَالَتْ
body: أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْعَصْرِ فَشُغِلَ عَنْهُمَا فَرَكَعَهُمَا حِينَ غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَلَمْ أَرَهُ يُصَلِّيهِمَا قَبْلُ وَلاَ بَعْدُ

h2_title_en: Concession Allowing Prayer Before Maghrib
h2_title: باب الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ قَبْلَ الْمَغْرِبِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAlī b. ʿUthmān b. Muḥammad b. Saʿīd b. ʿAbdullāh b. Nufayl > Saʿīd b. ʿĪsá > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim > Bakr b. Muḍar > ʿAmr b. al-Ḥārith > Yazīd b. Abū Ḥabīb > Abū al-Khayr > Abū Tamīm al-Jayshānī Qām Liyarkaʿ Rakʿatayn Qabl al-Maghrib > Liʿuqbah b. ʿĀmir Ānẓur > Hadhā a Ṣalāh Yuṣallī And al-Tafat Ilayh Farāh
body_en: Abu Tamim Al-Jaishani stood up to pray two Rak'ahs before Maghrib, and I said to 'Uqbah bin 'Amir: 'Look at this man, what prayer is he praying?' He turned and looked at him, and said: 'This is a prayer that we used to pray at the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عِيسَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا بَكْرُ بْنُ مُضَرَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ أَنَّ أَبَا الْخَيْرِ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا تَمِيمٍ الْجَيْشَانِيَّ قَامَ لِيَرْكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْمَغْرِبِ فَقُلْتُ لِعُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ انْظُرْ إِلَى هَذَا أَىَّ صَلاَةٍ يُصَلِّي فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْهِ فَرَآهُ فَقَالَ
body: هَذِهِ صَلاَةٌ كُنَّا نُصَلِّيهَا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ

h2_title_en: Prayer After The Appearance of Dawn
title: null
chain_en: Aḥmad b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Ḥakam > Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar > Shuʿbah > Zayd b. Muḥammad > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar > Ḥafṣah
body_en: When the dawn appears, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ would only pray two short Rak'ahs.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ نَافِعًا يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ حَفْصَةَ
body: أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ لاَ يُصَلِّي إِلاَّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ

h2_title_en: Permission To (Continue) Praying Until One Prays Subh
h2_title: باب إِبَاحَةِ الصَّلاَةِ إِلَى أَنْ يُصَلَّى الصُّبْحُ
title: null
chain_en: al-Ḥasan b. Ismāʿīl b. Sulaymān And ʾAyyūb b. Muḥammad > Ḥajjāj b. Muḥammad > Ayyūb > Ḥasan > Shuʿbah > Yaʿlá b. ʿAṭāʾ > Yazīd b. Ṭalq > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Baylamānī > ʿAmr b. ʿAbasah
body_en:
I came to the Messenger of Allah, who became Muslim with you?' He said: 'Free men and slaves.' I said: 'Is there any moment which brings one closer to Allah than another?' He said: 'Yes, the last part of the night, so pray as much as you want until you pray Subh, then stop until the sun has risen until and it looks like a shield and (its shinning)spreads. Then pray as much as you want until an object's shadow is at its shortest, then stop until the sun passes its zenith, for Hell is stoked at midday. Then pray 'Asr, then stop until you pray 'Asr, then stop until the sun has set, for it sets between the horns of a Shaitan and rises between the horns of a Shaitan.'" h2_title_en: The Time When A Traveler May Combine Zuhr And 'Asr Prayers
h2_title: باب الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي يَجْمَعُ فِيهِ الْمُسَافِرُ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Mufaḍḍal > ʿUqayl > Ibn Shihāb > Anas b. Mālik
body_en:
If the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was setting out on a journey before the sun passed its zenith, he would delay Zuhr until the time of 'Asr, then he would stop and combine the prayer. h2_title_en: Times During Which A Resident May Combine Prayers
h2_title: باب الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي يَجْمَعُ فِيهِ الْمُقِيمُ
title: null
chain_en: Abū ʿĀṣim Khushaysh b. Aṣram > Ḥabbān b. Hilāl > Ḥabīb / Ibn Abū Ḥabīb > ʿAmr b. Harim > Jābir b. Zayd > Ibn ʿAbbās > Ṣallá Bi-al-Baṣrah al-Ūlá Wa-al-ʿAṣr Lays Baynahumā Shaʾ Wa-al-Maghrib Wa-al-ʿIshāʾ Lays Baynahumā Shaʾ Faʿal Dhalik from Shughl Wazaʿam Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Abbas that he prayed Al-Uula (Zuhr) and 'Asr together in Al-Basrah with nothing in between them, and he prayed Maghrib and 'Isha' together with nothing in between them. He did that because he was busy and Ibn 'Abbas said that he had prayed Zuhr and 'Isha' together with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Al-Madinah, eight Rak'ahs with nothing in between.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ خُشَيْشُ بْنُ أَصْرَمَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبٌ وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ هَرِمٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُ صَلَّى بِالْبَصْرَةِ الأُولَى وَالْعَصْرَ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَىْءٌ وَالْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَىْءٌ فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ شُغْلٍ وَزَعَمَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ
body: أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْمَدِينَةِ الأُولَى وَالْعَصْرَ ثَمَانِ سَجَدَاتٍ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُمَا شَىْءٌ

h2_title: باب الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي يَجْمَعُ فِيهِ الْمُسَافِرُ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ

I accompanied Ibn 'Umar to Al-Hima. chain: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ
body: عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا عَجِلَ بِهِ السَّيْرُ يُؤَخِّرُ الظُّهْرَ إِلَى وَقْتِ الْعَصْرِ فَيَجْمَعُ بَيْنَهُمَا وَيُؤَخِّرُ الْمَغْرِبَ حَتَّى يَجْمَعَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ الْعِشَاءِ حِينَ يَغِيبُ الشَّفَقُ

h2_title_en: The Time When A Traveler May Combine Maghrib and 'Isha'
h2_title: باب الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي يَجْمَعُ فِيهِ الْمُسَافِرُ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ
title: null
chain_en: Maḥmūd b. Khālid > al-Walīd > Ibn Jābir > Nāfiʿ
body_en: I went out with 'Abdullah bin 'Umar on a journey to some of his land. Then someone came to him and said: 'Safiyyah bint Abi 'Ubaid is sick, try to get there before it is too late.' He set out quickly, accompanied by a man of the Quraish. The sun set but he did not pray, although I knew him to be very careful about praying on time. When he slowed down I said: 'The prayer, may Allah have mercy on you.' He turned to me but carried on until the twilight was almost gone, then he stopped and prayed Maghrib, then he said the Iqamah for 'Isha', at that time the twilight had totally disappeared and led us in prayer. Then he turned to us and said: 'If the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in a hurry to travel he would do this.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جَابِرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ قَالَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ فِي سَفَرٍ يُرِيدُ أَرْضًا لَهُ فَأَتَاهُ آتٍ فَقَالَ
body: إِنَّ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ لَمَا بِهَا فَانْظُرْ أَنْ تُدْرِكَهَا فَخَرَجَ مُسْرِعًا وَمَعَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ يُسَايِرُهُ وَغَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ الصَّلاَةَ وَكَانَ عَهْدِي بِهِ وَهُوَ يُحَافِظُ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَلَمَّا أَبْطَأَ قُلْتُ الصَّلاَةَ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَىَّ وَمَضَى حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ فِي آخِرِ الشَّفَقِ نَزَلَ فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ أَقَامَ الْعِشَاءَ وَقَدْ تَوَارَى الشَّفَقُ فَصَلَّى بِنَا ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا عَجِلَ بِهِ السَّيْرُ صَنَعَ هَكَذَا

h2_title_en: The Time When A Traveler May Combine Maghrib and 'Isha'
h2_title: باب الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي يَجْمَعُ فِيهِ الْمُسَافِرُ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah b. Saʿīd > al-ʿAṭṭāf > Nāfiʿ
body_en: We came back with Ibn 'Umar from Makkah. One night he kept on travelling until evening came, and we thought that he had forgotten the prayer!' But he kept quiet and kept going until the twilight had almost disappeared, then he stopped and prayed, and when the twilight disappeared he prayed 'Isha'. Then he turned to us and said: This is what we used to do with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ if he was in a hurry to travel.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْعَطَّافُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ قَالَ أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ مِنْ مَكَّةَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةُ سَارَ بِنَا حَتَّى أَمْسَيْنَا فَظَنَنَّا
body: أَنَّهُ نَسِيَ الصَّلاَةَ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ الصَّلاَةَ فَسَكَتَ وَسَارَ حَتَّى كَادَ الشَّفَقُ أَنْ يَغِيبَ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ فَصَلَّى وَغَابَ الشَّفَقُ فَصَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ هَكَذَا كُنَّا نَصْنَعُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا جَدَّ بِهِ السَّيْرُ

h2_title_en: The Time When A Traveler May Combine Maghrib and 'Isha'
h2_title: باب الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي يَجْمَعُ فِيهِ الْمُسَافِرُ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAbdah b. ʿAbd al-Raḥīm > Ibn Shumayl > Kathīr b. Qārawandā > Saʾalnā Sālim b. ʿAbdullāh
body_en: We asked Salim bin 'Abdullah about prayer while traveling. We said: 'Did 'Abdullah combine any of his prayer while traveling?' He said: 'No, except at Jam'.'[1] Then he paused, and said: 'Safiyyah was married to him, and she sent word to him that she was in her last day in this world and the first day in the Hereafter. So he ride off in a hurry, and I was with him. The time for prayer came and the Mu'adhdhin said to him: 'The prayer, O Abu 'Abdur-Rahman! But he kept going until it was between the time for the two prayer. Then he stopped and said to the Mu'adhdhin: "Say the Iqamah, and when I say the Taslim at the end of Zuhr, say the Iqamah (again) straight away." So he said the Iqamah and he prayed Zuhr, two Rak'ahs, then he said the Iqamah (again) straight away, and he prayed 'Asr, two Rak'ahs. Then he rode off quickly until the sun set and the Mu'adhdhin said to him: "The prayer, O Abu 'Abdur-Rahman!" He said: "Do what you did before." He rode on until the starts appeared, then he stopped and said: "Say the Iqamah, then when I say the Taslim, say the Iqamah. So he said the Iqamah and he prayed Maghrib, three Rak'ahs, then he said the Iqamah (again) straight away and he prayed 'Isha', then he said one Taslim, turning his face. Then he said: "The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'If any one of you has urgent need that he fears he may miss, let him pray like this.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شُمَيْلٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ قَارَوَنْدَا قَالَ سَأَلْنَا سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
body: عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فِي السَّفَرِ فَقُلْنَا أَكَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ شَىْءٍ مِنَ الصَّلَوَاتِ فِي السَّفَرِ فَقَالَ لاَ إِلاَّ بِجَمْعٍ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ كَانَتْ عِنْدَهُ صَفِيَّةُ فَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَيْهِ أَنِّي فِي آخِرِ يَوْمٍ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَأَوَّلِ يَوْمٍ مِنَ الآخِرَةِ فَرَكِبَ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ فَأَسْرَعَ السَّيْرَ حَتَّى حَانَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ الصَّلاَةَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَسَارَ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ نَزَلَ فَقَالَ لِلْمُؤَذِّنِ أَقِمْ فَإِذَا سَلَّمْتُ مِنَ الظُّهْرِ فَأَقِمْ مَكَانَكَ فَأَقَامَ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ ثُمَّ أَقَامَ مَكَانَهُ فَصَلَّى الْعَصْرَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ رَكِبَ فَأَسْرَعَ السَّيْرَ حَتَّى غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ الصَّلاَةَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَقَالَ كَفِعْلِكَ الأَوَّلِ فَسَارَ حَتَّى إِذَا اشْتَبَكَتِ النُّجُومُ نَزَلَ فَقَالَ أَقِمْ فَإِذَا سَلَّمْتُ فَأَقِمْ فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ أَقَامَ مَكَانَهُ فَصَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ الآخِرَةَ ثُمَّ سَلَّمَ وَاحِدَةً تِلْقَاءَ وَجْهِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمْ أَمْرٌ يَخْشَى فَوْتَهُ فَلْيُصَلِّ هَذِهِ الصَّلاَةَ

h2_title_en: Situations During Which It Is Permissible To Combine Two Prayers
h2_title: باب الْحَالِ الَّتِي يُجْمَعُ فِيهَا بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah b. Saʿīd > Mālik > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that if the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in a hurry to travel, he would combine Maghrib and 'Isha'.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا جَدَّ بِهِ السَّيْرُ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ

h2_title_en: Situations During Which It Is Permissible To Combine Two Prayers
h2_title: باب الْحَالِ الَّتِي يُجْمَعُ فِيهَا بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ
title: null
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > ʿAbd al-Razzāq > Maʿmar > Mūsá b. ʿUqbah > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: If the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was in a hurry to travel, or some emergency arose, he would combine Maghrib and 'Isha'.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
body: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا جَدَّ بِهِ السَّيْرُ أَوْ حَزَبَهُ أَمْرٌ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ

h2_title_en: Situations During Which It Is Permissible To Combine Two Prayers
h2_title: باب الْحَالِ الَّتِي يُجْمَعُ فِيهَا بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Manṣūr > Sufyān > al-Zuhrī > Sālim from his father
body_en: I heard Az-Zuhri say: 'Salim told me that his father said: 'I saw the Prophet ﷺ, if he was in a hurry to travel, joining Maghrib and 'Isha'.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الزُّهْرِيَّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ
body: رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ إِذَا جَدَّ بِهِ السَّيْرُ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ

h2_title_en: Combining Two Prayers While A Resident
h2_title: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ فِي الْحَضَرِ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Mālik > Abū al-Zubayr > Saʿīd b. Jubayr > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ prayed Zuhr and 'Asr together, and Maghrib and 'Isha' together, when there was no fear and he was not traveling.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ جَمِيعًا وَالْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ جَمِيعًا مِنْ غَيْرِ خَوْفٍ وَلاَ سَفَرٍ

h2_title_en: Combining Two Prayers While A Resident
h2_title: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ فِي الْحَضَرِ
title: null
part: جمع من غير خوف ولا مطر أن لا يحرج أمته
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. Abū Rizmah Wāsmuh Ghazwān > al-Faḍl b. Mūsá > al-Aʿmash > Ḥabīb b. Abū Thābit > Saʿīd b. Jubayr > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: Why?" He said: "So that there would not be any hardship on his Ummah.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ أَبِي رِزْمَةَ وَاسْمُهُ غَزْوَانُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يُصَلِّي بِالْمَدِينَةِ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ مِنْ غَيْرِ خَوْفٍ وَلاَ مَطَرٍ قِيلَ لَهُ لِمَ قَالَ لِئَلاَّ يَكُونَ عَلَى أُمَّتِهِ حَرَجٌ

h2_title_en: Combining Two Prayers While A Resident
h2_title: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الصَّلاَتَيْنِ فِي الْحَضَرِ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlá > Khālid > Ibn Jurayj > ʿAmr b. Dīnār > Abū al-Shaʿthāʾ > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: I prayed behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ eight (Rak'ahs) together and seven (Rak'ahs) together.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: صَلَّيْتُ وَرَاءَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثَمَانِيًا جَمِيعًا وَسَبْعًا جَمِيعًا

h2_title_en: Combining Zuhr and 'Asr At 'Arafah
h2_title: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ بِعَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Ibrāhīm b. Hārūn > Ḥātim b. Ismāʿīl > Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father > Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ traveled until he came to 'Arafah, where he found that the tent had pitched for him. He stayed there until the sun had passed its zenith, then he called for Al-Qaswa' which was saddled for him. When he reached the bottom of the valley he addressed the people. Then Bilal called the Adhan, then the Iqamah, then he prayed Zuhr, then he called the Iqamah, then he prayed 'Asr, and he did not offer any other prayer in between.
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ هَارُونَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
body: سَارَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَتَّى أَتَى عَرَفَةَ فَوَجَدَ الْقُبَّةَ قَدْ ضُرِبَتْ لَهُ بِنَمِرَةَ فَنَزَلَ بِهَا حَتَّى إِذَا زَاغَتِ الشَّمْسُ أَمَرَ بِالْقَصْوَاءِ فَرُحِّلَتْ لَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا انْتَهَى إِلَى بَطْنِ الْوَادِي خَطَبَ النَّاسَ ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ بِلاَلٌ ثُمَّ أَقَامَ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ ثُمَّ أَقَامَ فَصَلَّى الْعَصْرَ وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ بَيْنَهُمَا شَيْئًا

h2_title_en: Combining Maghrib and 'Isha' At Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah b. Saʿīd > Mālik > Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd > ʿAdī b. Thābit > ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd > Abū Ayyūb al-Anṣārī
body_en: It was narrated from 'Abdullah bin Yazid that Abu Ayyub Al-Ansari told him, that during the Farewell Pilgrimage. He prayed with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ Maghrib and 'Isha' prayers together at Al-Muzdalifah.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَنَّ أَبَا أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيَّ
body: أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ صَلَّى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ جَمِيعًا

h2_title_en: Combining Maghrib and 'Isha' At Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm > Hushaym > Ismāʿīl b. Abū Khālid > Abū Isḥāq > Saʿīd b. Jubayr
body_en: I was with Ibn 'Umar when he departed from 'Arafah. When he came to Jam' (Al-Muzdalifah), he combined Maghrib and 'Isha', and when he finished he said: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did similar to this in this place.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ حَيْثُ أَفَاضَ مِنْ عَرَفَاتٍ فَلَمَّا أَتَى جَمْعًا جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَالَ
body: فَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي هَذَا الْمَكَانِ مِثْلَ هَذَا

h2_title_en: Combining Maghrib and 'Isha' At Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. Saʿīd > ʿAbd al-Raḥman > Mālik > al-Zuhrī > Sālim > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: It was narrated from Ibn 'Umar that the Prophet ﷺ prayed Maghrib and 'Isha' at Al-Muzdalifah.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ

h2_title_en: Combining Maghrib and 'Isha' At Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Sufyān > al-Aʿmash > ʿUmārah > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd > ʿAbdullāh
body_en: I never saw the Messenger of Allah ﷺ combine any two prayers except in Al-Muzdalifah, and on that day he prayed Subh before its time.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
body: مَا رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ صَلاَتَيْنِ إِلاَّ بِجَمْعٍ وَصَلَّى الصُّبْحَ يَوْمَئِذٍ قَبْلَ وَقْتِهَا

h2_title_en: How To Combine Prayers
title: null
chain_en: al-Ḥusayn b. Ḥurayth > Sufyān > Ibrāhīm b. ʿUqbah And Muḥammad b. Abū Ḥarmalah > Kurayb > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: I poured water for him from a small vessel and he performed a light Wudu'. I said to him: 'The prayer.' He said: 'The prayer is still ahead of you.' When he came to Al-Muzdalifah he prayed Maghrib, then they untied the saddles of their mounts and then he prayed 'Isha'.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ حُرَيْثٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَرْمَلَةَ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَرْدَفَهُ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ فَلَمَّا أَتَى الشِّعْبَ نَزَلَ فَبَالَ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَهْرَاقَ الْمَاءَ قَالَ فَصَبَبْتُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ إِدَاوَةٍ فَتَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا خَفِيفًا فَقُلْتُ لَهُ الصَّلاَةَ فَقَالَ الصَّلاَةُ أَمَامَكَ فَلَمَّا أَتَى الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ صَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ نَزَعُوا رِحَالَهُمْ ثُمَّ صَلَّى الْعِشَاءَ

h2_title_en: The Virtue Of Prayer During Its Time
title: null
chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿAlī > Yaḥyá > Shuʿbah > al-Walīd b. al-ʿAyzār > Abū ʿAmr al-Shaybānī > Ṣāḥib Hadhih al-Dār And ʾAshār > Dār ʿAbdullāh
body_en: I heard Abu 'Amr Ash-Shaibani say: 'The owner of this house - and he pointed to the house of 'Abdullah - said: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: 'Which deed is most beloved to Allah, may He be exalted?' He said: 'Prayer offered on time, honoring one's parents, and Jihad in the cause of Allah.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ الْعَيْزَارِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَمْرٍو الشَّيْبَانِيَّ يَقُولُ
body: حَدَّثَنَا صَاحِبُ هَذِهِ الدَّارِ وَأَشَارَ إِلَى دَارِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَىُّ الْعَمَلِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى قَالَ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَى وَقْتِهَا وَبِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ﷻ

h2_title_en: The Virtue Of Prayer During Its Time
title: null
chain_en: ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman > Sufyān > Abū Muʿāwiyah al-Nakhaʿī Samiʿah from Abū ʿAmr > ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd
body_en: I asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ which action is most beloved to Allah? He said: 'Establishing prayer on time, honoring one's parents and Jihad in the cause of Allah.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ
body: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ النَّخَعِيُّ سَمِعَهُ مِنْ أَبِي عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَىُّ الْعَمَلِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ ﷻ قَالَ إِقَامُ الصَّلاَةِ لِوَقْتِهَا وَبِرُّ الْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْجِهَادُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ﷻ

h2_title_en: The Virtue Of Prayer During Its Time
title: null
chain_en: Yaḥyá b. Ḥakīm And ʿAmrū b. Yazīd > Ibn Abū ʿAdī > Shuʿbah > Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad b. al-Muntashir from his father
body_en:
I was praying Witr, and 'Abdullah was asked: 'Is there any Witr after the Adhan?' He said: "Yes, and after the Iqamah, and he narrated that the Prophet ﷺ slept and missed the prayer until the sun rose then prayed.'" h2_title_en: Concerning One Who Sleeps And Misses A Prayer
title: null
chain_en: Ḥumayd b. Masʿadah > Yazīd > Ḥajjāj al-Aḥwal > Qatādah > Anas
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was asked about a man who slept and missed the prayer, or forgot it. He said: 'The expiation for that is to pray it when he remembers it.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ عَنْ يَزِيدَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ الأَحْوَلُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ
body: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَرْقُدُ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ أَوْ يَغْفُلُ عَنْهَا قَالَ كَفَّارَتُهَا أَنْ يُصَلِّيَهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا

h2_title_en: Concerning One Who Sleeps And Misses A Prayer
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Ḥammād b. Zayd > Thābit > ʿAbdullāh b. Rabāḥ > Abū Qatādah > Dhakarūā Lilnnabī ﷺ Nawmahum > al-Ṣalāh
body_en: They told the Prophet ﷺ that they had slept and missed the prayer. He said: 'There is no negligence when one sleeps, rather negligence is when one is awake. If any one of you forgets a prayer or sleeps and misses it, let him pray it when he remembers it.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ قَالَ
body: ذَكَرُوا لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ نَوْمَهُمْ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي النَّوْمِ تَفْرِيطٌ إِنَّمَا التَّفْرِيطُ فِي الْيَقَظَةِ فَإِذَا نَسِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ صَلاَةً أَوْ نَامَ عَنْهَا فَلْيُصَلِّهَا إِذَا ذَكَرَهَا

h2_title_en: Concerning One Who Sleeps And Misses A Prayer
title: null
chain_en: Sūwayd b. Naṣr > ʿAbdullāh / Ibn al-Mubārak > Sulaymān b. al-Mughīrah > Thābit > ʿAbdullāh b. Rabāḥ > Abū Qatādah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'There is no negligence when one sleeps, rather negligence is when one does not offer one prayer until the time of the next prayer comes and he realizes that he has missed a prayer.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَيْسَ فِي النَّوْمِ تَفْرِيطٌ إِنَّمَا التَّفْرِيطُ فِيمَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ الصَّلاَةَ حَتَّى يَجِيءَ وَقْتُ الصَّلاَةِ الأُخْرَى حِينَ يَنْتَبِهُ لَهَا

h2_title_en: Repeating A Prayer That One Missed Because Of Sleep During Its Time The Next Day
h2_title: باب إِعَادَةِ مَا نَامَ عَنْهُ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ لِوَقْتِهَا مِنَ الْغَدِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿAlī > Abū Dāwud > Shuʿbah > Thābit al-Bunānī > ʿAbdullāh b. Rabāḥ > Abū Qatādah
body_en: Let any one of you pray it during its time tomorrow.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَمَّا نَامُوا عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلْيُصَلِّهَا أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ الْغَدِ لِوَقْتِهَا

h2_title_en: Repeating A Prayer That One Missed Because Of Sleep During Its Time The Next Day
h2_title: باب إِعَادَةِ مَا نَامَ عَنْهُ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ لِوَقْتِهَا مِنَ الْغَدِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAbd al-Aʿlá b. Wāṣil b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlá > Yaʿlá > Muḥammad b. Isḥāq > al-Zuhrī > Saʿīd > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: If you forget a prayer, pray it when you remember it, for Allah says: "and perform the Salah for My remembrance." [1] [1] Ta-Ha 20:14.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ وَاصِلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا نَسِيتَ الصَّلاَةَ فَصَلِّ إِذَا ذَكَرْتَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ { أَقِمِ الصَّلاَةَ لِذِكْرِي } قَالَ عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا بِهِ يَعْلَى مُخْتَصَرًا

h2_title_en: Repeating A Prayer That One Missed Because Of Sleep During Its Time The Next Day

h2_title_en: How Should One Who Has Missed A Prayer Make It Up?
h2_title: باب كَيْفَ يُقْضَى الْفَائِتُ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Hannād b. al-Sarī > Abū al-Aḥwaṣ > ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib > Burayd b. Abū Maryam from his father
body_en: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ on a journey, and we kept going one night, then when it was nearly morning the Messenger of Allah ﷺ dismounted and slept, and the people slept too. We did not wake up until the sun had risen. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked the Mu'adhdhin to call the Adhan, then he prayed the two Rak'ahs before Fajr, then he asked him to say the Iqamah, then he led the people in prayer. Then he told us about everything that will happen until the Hour begins.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ
body: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي سَفَرٍ فَأَسْرَيْنَا لَيْلَةً فَلَمَّا كَانَ فِي وَجْهِ الصُّبْحِ نَزَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَنَامَ وَنَامَ النَّاسُ فَلَمْ نَسْتَيْقِظْ إِلاَّ بِالشَّمْسِ قَدْ طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْنَا فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمُؤَذِّنَ فَأَذَّنَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ الْفَجْرِ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ فَأَقَامَ فَصَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ ثُمَّ حَدَّثَنَا بِمَا هُوَ كَائِنٌ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ

h2_title_en: How Should One Who Has Missed A Prayer Make It Up?
h2_title: باب كَيْفَ يُقْضَى الْفَائِتُ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Sūwayd b. Naṣr > ʿAbdullāh > Hishām al-Dastawāʾī > Abū al-Zubayr > Nāfiʿ b. Jubayr b. Muṭʿim > Abū ʿUbaydah b. ʿAbdullāh > ʿAbdullāh b. Masʿūd
body_en: We were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and we were prevented from praying Zuhr, 'Asr, Maghrib and 'Isha'. I felt very upset about that and I said to myself: 'We are with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and (fighting) for the sake of Allah.' Then the Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded Bilal to say the Iqamah and he led us in praying Zuhr. Then he said the Iqamah and he led us in praying 'Asr. Then he said the Iqamah and he led us in praying Maghrib. Then he said the Iqamah and he led us in praying 'Isha'. Then he went around among us and told us: 'There is no group on Earth who is remembering Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, except you.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ نَصْرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ هِشَامٍ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ
body: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَحُبِسْنَا عَنْ صَلاَةِ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ فَاشْتَدَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَىَّ فَقُلْتُ فِي نَفْسِي نَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِلاَلاً فَأَقَامَ فَصَلَّى بِنَا الظُّهْرَ ثُمَّ أَقَامَ فَصَلَّى بِنَا الْعَصْرَ ثُمَّ أَقَامَ فَصَلَّى بِنَا الْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ أَقَامَ فَصَلَّى بِنَا الْعِشَاءَ ثُمَّ طَافَ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ مَا عَلَى الأَرْضِ عِصَابَةٌ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ ﷻ غَيْرُكُمْ

h2_title_en: How Should One Who Has Missed A Prayer Make It Up?
h2_title: باب كَيْفَ يُقْضَى الْفَائِتُ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm > Yaḥyá > Yazīd b. Kaysān > Abū Ḥāzim > Abū Hurayrah
body_en: We stopped to camp at the end of the night with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, and we did not wake up until the sun had risen. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Let each man take hold of his camel's head (and leave), for the Shaitan was here in this place with us.' We did that, then he called for water and performed Wudu', then he prayed two Rak'ahs, then the Iqamah was said and he prayed Al-Ghadah (Fajr).
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ
body: عَرَّسْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَلَمْ نَسْتَيْقِظْ حَتَّى طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لِيَأْخُذْ كُلُّ رَجُلٍ بِرَأْسِ رَاحِلَتِهِ فَإِنَّ هَذَا مَنْزِلٌ حَضَرَنَا فِيهِ الشَّيْطَانُ قَالَ فَفَعَلْنَا فَدَعَا بِالْمَاءِ فَتَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى سَجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَصَلَّى الْغَدَاةَ

h2_title_en: How Should One Who Has Missed A Prayer Make It Up?
h2_title: باب كَيْفَ يُقْضَى الْفَائِتُ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Abū ʿĀṣim Khushaysh b. Aṣram > Yaḥyá b. Ḥassān > Ḥammād b. Salamah > ʿAmr b. Dīnār > Nāfiʿ b. Jubayr from his father
body_en: Who will watch out for dawn for us, so that we do not sleep and miss the dawn prayer?" Bilal said: 'I will.' He turned to face the direction where the sun woke them up, then they got up. He said: 'Perform Wudu'.' Then Bilal called the Adhan and he prayed two Rak'ahs, and they prayed the two (Sunnah) Rak'ahs of Fajr, then they prayed Fajr.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ خُشَيْشُ بْنُ أَصْرَمَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ فِي سَفَرٍ لَهُ مَنْ يَكْلَؤُنَا اللَّيْلَةَ لاَ نَرْقُدَ عَنْ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ قَالَ بِلاَلٌ أَنَا فَاسْتَقْبَلَ مَطْلَعَ الشَّمْسِ فَضُرِبَ عَلَى آذَانِهِمْ حَتَّى أَيْقَظَهُمْ حَرُّ الشَّمْسِ فَقَامُوا فَقَالَ تَوَضَّئُوا ثُمَّ أَذَّنَ بِلاَلٌ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَصَلَّوْا رَكْعَتَىِ الْفَجْرِ ثُمَّ صَلَّوُا الْفَجْرَ

h2_title_en: How Should One Who Has Missed A Prayer Make It Up?
h2_title: باب كَيْفَ يُقْضَى الْفَائِتُ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Abū ʿĀṣim > Ḥabbān b. Hilāl > Ḥabīb > ʿAmr b. Harim > Jābir b. Zayd > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ set out at nightfall, then stopped to camp at the end of the night, and he did not wake up until the sun had risen or had partly risen. He did not pray until the sun had risen (fully), then he prayed, and that was the 'middle prayer' (Salat Al-Wusta).
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبٌ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ هَرِمٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: أَدْلَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ عَرَّسَ فَلَمْ يَسْتَيْقِظْ حَتَّى طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ أَوْ بَعْضُهَا فَلَمْ يُصَلِّ حَتَّى ارْتَفَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَصَلَّى وَهِيَ صَلاَةُ الْوُسْطَى

h2_title_en: How The Adhan Began
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl And ʾIbrāhīm b. al-Ḥasan > Ḥajjāj > Ibn Jurayj > Nāfiʿ > ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUmar > Kān
body_en: When the Muslims arrived in Al-Madinah they used to gather and try to figure out the time for prayer, and no one gave the call to prayer. One day they spoke about that; some of them said: 'Let us use a bell like the Christians do;' others said, 'No, a horn like the Jews have.' 'Umar, may ,Allah be pleased with him, said: 'Why don't you send a man to announce the time of prayer?' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'O Bilal, get up and give the call to prayer.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ
body: أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ كَانَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ حِينَ قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ يَجْتَمِعُونَ فَيَتَحَيَّنُونَ الصَّلاَةَ وَلَيْسَ يُنَادِي بِهَا أَحَدٌ فَتَكَلَّمُوا يَوْمًا فِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمُ اتَّخِذُوا نَاقُوسًا مِثْلَ نَاقُوسِ النَّصَارَى وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ بَلْ قَرْنًا مِثْلَ قَرْنِ الْيَهُودِ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ؓ أَوَلاَ تَبْعَثُونَ رَجُلاً يُنَادِي بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَا بِلاَلُ قُمْ فَنَادِ بِالصَّلاَةِ

h2_title_en: Saying The Phrases of The Adhan Twice
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah b. Saʿīd > ʿAbd al-Wahhāb > Ayyūb > Abū Qilābah > Anas
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ commanded Bilal to say the phrases of the Adhan twice and the phrases of the Iqamah once.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ
body: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَمَرَ بِلاَلاً أَنْ يَشْفَعَ الأَذَانَ وَأَنْ يُوتِرَ الإِقَامَةَ

h2_title_en: Saying The Phrases of The Adhan Twice
title: null
chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿAlī > Yaḥyá > Shuʿbah > Abū Jaʿfar > Abū al-Muthanná > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: At the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ the phrases of the Adhan were said twice and the phrases of the Iqamah were said once, except that you should say: 'Qad Qamatis-Salah, Qad Qamatis-Salah (prayer is about to begin, prayer is about to begin).'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمُثَنَّى عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
body: كَانَ الأَذَانُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَثْنَى مَثْنَى وَالإِقَامَةُ مَرَّةً مَرَّةً إِلاَّ أَنَّكَ تَقُولُ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلاَةُ قَدْ قَامَتِ الصَّلاَةُ

h2_title_en: Lowering The Voice When Saying Some Phrases Of The Adhan The Second Time
h2_title: باب خَفْضِ الصَّوْتِ فِي التَّرْجِيعِ فِي الأَذَانِ
title: null

h2_title_en: The Adhan When Travelling
title: null
chain_en: Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥasan And Yūsuf b. Saʿīd > Ḥajjāj > Ibn Jurayj > ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz b. ʿAbd al-Malik b. Abū Maḥdhūrah > ʿAbdullāh b. Muḥayrīz
body_en: he said: "I said to Abu Mahdhurah: 'I am going to Ash-Sham and I am afraid that I will be asked about how you say the Adhan. "'He told me that Abu Mahdhurah said to him, I went out with a group of people and we were somewhere on the road to Hunain when the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was coming back from Hunain. The Messenger of Allah met us somewhere on the road and the Muadhdhin of the Messenger of Allah called the Adhan for prayer in the presence of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. We heard the voice of the Muadh'dhin and we were careless about it (the Adhan), so we started yelling, immitating and mocking it. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ heard us, so he sent some people who brought us to stand in front of him. He said, 'Who is the one whose voice I heard so loud?' The people all pointed to me, and they were telling the truth. He sent them all away, but kept me there and said to me: 'Stand up and call the Adhan for the Prayer.' I stood up and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ taught me the Adhan himself. He Said, 'Say: 'Allahu Akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah (Allah is the Greatest,Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah; I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger Allah,I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger Allah).' Then he said: 'Then repeat and say in a loud voice:Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah; Hayya 'alas-salah, Hayya 'ala-salah; Hayya 'alal-falah Hayya 'alal-falah; Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; La ilaha ill-Allah (I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah; I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; Come to prayer, come to prayer; come to prosperity, come to prosperity; Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; there is none worthy of worship except Allah).' Then he called me when I had finished saying the Adhan, and he gave me a bundle in which there was some silver. I said: 'O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, let me be the one doing the Adhan in Makkah.' He said: 'I command you to do so.' Then I came to 'Attab bin Asid who was the governor of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Makkah, and I called the Adhan for prayer with him upon the orders of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ وَيُوسُفُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مُحَيْرِيزٍ
body: أَخْبَرَهُ وَكَانَ يَتِيمًا فِي حَجْرِ أَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ حَتَّى جَهَّزَهُ إِلَى الشَّامِ قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَبِي مَحْذُورَةَ إِنِّي خَارِجٌ إِلَى الشَّامِ وَأَخْشَى أَنْ أُسْأَلَ عَنْ تَأْذِينِكَ فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ أَبَا مَحْذُورَةَ قَالَ لَهُ خَرَجْتُ فِي نَفَرٍ فَكُنَّا بِبَعْضِ طَرِيقِ حُنَيْنٍ مَقْفَلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ حُنَيْنٍ فَلَقِيَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي بَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ فَأَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالصَّلاَةِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَمِعْنَا صَوْتَ الْمُؤَذِّنِ وَنَحْنُ عَنْهُ مُتَنَكِّبُونَ فَظَلِلْنَا نَحْكِيهِ وَنَهْزَأُ بِهِ فَسَمِعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الصَّوْتَ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْنَا حَتَّى وَقَفْنَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَيُّكُمُ الَّذِي سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَهُ قَدِ ارْتَفَعَ فَأَشَارَ الْقَوْمُ إِلَىَّ وَصَدَقُوا فَأَرْسَلَهُمْ كُلَّهُمْ وَحَبَسَنِي فَقَالَ قُمْ فَأَذِّنْ بِالصَّلاَةِ فَقُمْتُ فَأَلْقَى عَلَىَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ التَّأْذِينَ هُوَ بِنَفْسِهِ قَالَ قُلِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ارْجِعْ فَامْدُدْ صَوْتَكَ ثُمَّ قَالَ قُلْ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ حَىَّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ حَىَّ عَلَى الصَّلاَةِ حَىَّ عَلَى الْفَلاَحِ حَىَّ عَلَى الْفَلاَحِ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ دَعَانِي حِينَ قَضَيْتُ التَّأْذِينَ فَأَعْطَانِي صُرَّةً فِيهَا شَىْءٌ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مُرْنِي بِالتَّأْذِينِ بِمَكَّةَ فَقَالَ قَدْ أَمَرْتُكَ بِهِ فَقَدِمْتُ عَلَى عَتَّابِ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ عَامِلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِمَكَّةَ فَأَذَّنْتُ مَعَهُ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ

chain_en: Ibrāhīm b. al-Ḥasan > Ḥajjāj > Ibn Jurayj > ʿUthmān b. al-Sāʾib > Abū And ʾUm ʿAbd al-Malik b. Abū Maḥdhūrah > Abū Maḥdhūrah
body_en:
When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ left Hunain, I was the tenth of a group of ten of the people of Makkah who were trying to catch up with them. We heard them calling the Adhan for the prayer and we started to repeat the Adhan, mocking them. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'I heard among these people the Adhan of one who has a beautiful voice.' He sent for us, and we recited the Adhan one by one, and I was the last of them. When I said the Adhan, he said: 'Come here.' He sat me down in front of him and rubbed my forelock and blessed me three times, then he said, 'Go and give the Adhan at the sacred House.' I said: 'How, O Messenger of Allah?' He taught me as you say the Adhan now: 'Allahu Akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah; Hayya 'alas-salah, Hayya 'ala-salah; Hayya 'alal-falah Hayya 'alal-falah; as-salatu khairun min an-nawm;as-salatu khairun min an-nawm; (Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah; I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger Allah, I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger Allah; I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah; I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; Come to prayer, come to prayer; come to prosperity, come to prosperity; prayer is better than sleep, prayer is better than sleep)' - in the first (Adhan) for As-Subh (Fajr). And he taught me the Iqamah saying each phrase twice: 'Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, (Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar), Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah, Ashhadu an la ilaha illallah; Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah, Ashhadu anna Muhammadan Rasulallah; Hayya 'alas-salah, Hayya 'alas-salah; Hayya 'alal-falah, Hayya 'alal-falah; qad qamatis-salah, qad qamati-salah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar La ilaha illallah (Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, (Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest); I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah, I bear witness that there is none worthy of worship except Allah ; I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; Come to prayer, come to prayer; come to prosperity, come to prosperity; the prayer is about to begin, the prayer is about to begin, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest; there is none worthy of worship except Allah)." (One of the narrators) Ibn Juraij said: ''Uthman narrated this whole report to me from his father and from Umm 'Abdul-Malik bin Abi Mahdhurah, and (said that) they heard that from Abu h2_title_en: The Adhan Of Someone Else Is Sufficient While A Resident
h2_title: باب اجْتِزَاءِ الْمَرْءِ بِأَذَانِ غَيْرِهِ فِي الْحَضَرِ
title: null
chain_en: Ziyād b. Ayyūb > Ismāʿīl > Ayyūb > Abū Qilābah > Mālik b. al-Ḥūwayrith
body_en: We came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and we were young men close in age. He let us stay with him for twenty days. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was merciful and compassionate, and he thought that we were missing our families; he asked us about those whom we had left behind of our families, so we told him, and he said: 'Go back to your families, stay with them and teach them. Tell them when the time for prayer comes; let one of you call the Adhan and let the oldest of you lead the prayer.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ أَيُّوبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ قَالَ
body: أَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَنَحْنُ شَبَبَةٌ مُتَقَارِبُونَ فَأَقَمْنَا عِنْدَهُ عِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَحِيمًا رَفِيقًا فَظَنَّ أَنَّا قَدِ اشْتَقْنَا إِلَى أَهْلِنَا فَسَأَلَنَا عَمَّنْ تَرَكْنَاهُ مِنْ أَهْلِنَا فَأَخْبَرْنَاهُ فَقَالَ ارْجِعُوا إِلَى أَهْليِكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا عِنْدَهُمْ وَعَلِّمُوهُمْ وَمُرُوهُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَلْيُؤَذِّنْ لَكُمْ أَحَدُكُمْ وَلْيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَكْبَرُكُمْ

h2_title_en: The Adhan Of Someone Else Is Sufficient While A Resident
h2_title: باب اجْتِزَاءِ الْمَرْءِ بِأَذَانِ غَيْرِهِ فِي الْحَضَرِ
title: null
chain_en: Ibrāhīm b. Yaʿqūb > Sulaymān b. Ḥarb > Ḥammād b. Zayd > Ayyūb > Abū Qilābah > ʿAmr b. Salimah > Lī Abū Qilābah > Ḥa Afalā Talqāh > Ayyūb Falaqītuh Fasaʾaltuh
body_en: Abu Qilabah said to me (Ayyub): He ('Amr) is still alive, do you want to meet him?" I met him and asked him, and he said: "When Makkah was conquered, all the people hastened to announce their Islam. My father went to announce the Islam of the poeple of our village, and when he came back we went to see him and he said: 'By Allah, I have indeed come to you from the Messenger of Allah ﷺ'. He said: 'Pray such and such a prayer at such and such a time, pray such and such a prayer at such and such a time. When the time for prayer comes let one of you call the Adhan and let the one who knows the most Qur'an lead the prayer.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَلِمَةَ فَقَالَ
body: لِي أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ هُوَ حَىٌّ أَفَلاَ تَلْقَاهُ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ فَلَقِيتُهُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ وَقْعَةُ الْفَتْحِ بَادَرَ كُلُّ قَوْمٍ بِإِسْلاَمِهِمْ فَذَهَبَ أَبِي بِإِسْلاَمِ أَهْلِ حِوَائِنَا فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ اسْتَقْبَلْنَاهُ فَقَالَ جِئْتُكُمْ وَاللَّهِ مِنْ عِنْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ حَقًّا فَقَالَ صَلُّوا صَلاَةَ كَذَا فِي حِينِ كَذَا وَصَلاَةَ كَذَا فِي حِينِ كَذَا فَإِذَا حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَلْيُؤَذِّنْ لَكُمْ أَحَدُكُمْ وَلْيَؤُمَّكُمْ أَكْثَرُكُمْ قُرْآنًا

h2_title_en: Two Mu'adhdhins In One Masjid
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Mālik > ʿAbdullāh b. Dīnār > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: Bilal calls the Adhan during the night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktum calls (the Adhan)
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ عَنْ مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ إِنَّ بِلاَلاً يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يُنَادِيَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ

h2_title_en: Two Mu'adhdhins In One Masjid
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > al-Layth > Ibn Shihāb > Sālim from his father
body_en: Bilal calls the Adhan during the night, so eat and drink until you hear Ibn Umm Maktoom calling the Adhan.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ قَالَ إِنَّ بِلاَلاً يُؤَذِّنُ بِلَيْلٍ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى تَسْمَعُوا تَأْذِينَ ابْنِ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ

h2_title_en: Should They Call The Adhan Together or Separately?
h2_title: باب هَلْ يُؤَذِّنَانِ جَمِيعًا أَوْ فُرَادَى
title: null
chain_en: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm > Ḥafṣ > ʿUbaydullāh > al-Qāsim > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Bilal calls the Adhan during the night, so eat and drink until Ibn Umm Maktum calls the Adhan." She said: "And there was no more between than the time it takes for one to come down and the other to go up.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَذَّنَ بِلاَلٌ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا حَتَّى يُؤَذِّنَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ قَالَتْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ بَيْنَهُمَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَنْزِلَ هَذَا وَيَصْعَدَ هَذَا

h2_title_en: Should They Call The Adhan Together or Separately?
h2_title: باب هَلْ يُؤَذِّنَانِ جَمِيعًا أَوْ فُرَادَى
title: null
chain_en: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm > Hushaym > Manṣūr > Khubayb b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman > ʿAmmatih Unaysah
body_en: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When Ibn Umm Maktum calls the Adhan, eat and drink, and when Bilal calls the Adhan, do not eat nor drink.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا مَنْصُورٌ عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَمَّتِهِ أُنَيْسَةَ قَالَتْ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِذَا أَذَّنَ ابْنُ أُمِّ مَكْتُومٍ فَكُلُوا وَاشْرَبُوا وَإِذَا أَذَّنَ بِلاَلٌ فَلاَ تَأْكُلُوا وَلاَ تَشْرَبُوا

h2_title_en: The Adhan At Times Other Than The Time For Prayer
h2_title: باب الأَذَانِ فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتِ الصَّلاَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > al-Muʿtamir b. Sulaymān from his father > Abū ʿUthmān > Ibn Masʿūd
body_en:
Bilal calls the Adhan during the night to wake those who are sleeping and so that those who are praying Qiyam can return.[1] Not to say it is like this." The break of dawn is not like this. [2] [1] Meaning to finish. Ash-Shawkani said: "To return to sleeping or return to sitting from praying" Nail Al-Awtar. [2] Indicating with an up and down motion.
