body_en: he used to lead Ib Abbas and make him stand at the third side (of the Kabah next to the corner that is next to the stone, in between the stone and the door. Ibn Abbas said: "Have you head that the Messenger of Allah used to pray here?" He said: "Yes." So he went forward and prayed. (Daif) Chaper 134. The Virtue Of Circumambulationg The House, Which Is From The Book Al-Mujtaba About Hajj
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا السَّائِبُ بْنُ عُمَرَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُودُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ وَيُقِيمُهُ عِنْدَ الشُّقَّةِ الثَّالِثَةِ مِمَّا يَلِي الرُّكْنَ الَّذِي يَلِي الْحَجَرَ مِمَّا يَلِي الْبَابَ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَمَا أُنْبِئْتَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يُصَلِّي هَا هُنَا فَيَقُولُ نَعَمْ فَيَتَقَدَّمُ فَيُصَلِّي

h2_title_en: Chapter on Mentioning the Virtue of Circumambulation around the Kaaba
h2_title: باب ذِكْرِ الْفَضْلِ فِي الطَّوَافِ بِالْبَيْتِ
title: null
chain_en: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥman Aḥmad b. Shuʿayb from Lafẓih > Qutaybah > Ḥammād > ʿAṭāʾ > ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUbayd b. ʿUmayr > a man
body_en: O Abu abdur-Rahman, why do I only see you touching these two corners?" He said: "I heard the Messenger of Allah say: 'Touching them erases sins.' And I head him say: 'whoever circumambulates seven times, it is like freeing a slave.'
chain: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ مِنْ لَفْظِهِ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ
body: أَنَّ رَجُلاً قَالَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ مَا أَرَاكَ تَسْتَلِمُ إِلاَّ هَذَيْنِ الرُّكْنَيْنِ قَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ إِنَّ مَسْحَهُمَا يَحُطَّانِ الْخَطِيئَةَ وَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ مَنْ طَافَ سَبْعًا فَهُوَ كَعِدْلِ رَقَبَةٍ

h2_title_en: Speaking During Tawaf
title: null
chain_en: Yūsuf b. Saʿīd > Ḥajjāj > Ibn Jurayj > Sulaymān al-Aḥwal > Ṭāwus > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: That the Prophet passed by while he was circumambulating the Kabah with a man who was leading another with a ring in his nose. The Messenger of Allah stopped him with his hand then told him to lead him by his hand.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ الأَحْوَلُ أَنَّ طَاوُسًا أَخْبَرَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ مَرَّ وَهُوَ يَطُوفُ بِالْكَعْبَةِ بِإِنْسَانٍ يَقُودُهُ إِنْسَانٌ بِخِزَامَةٍ فِي أَنْفِهِ فَقَطَعَهُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَقُودَهُ بِيَدِهِ

h2_title_en: How A Sick Person May Perfom Tawaf
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Salamah And al-Ḥārith b. Miskīn > Ibn al-Qāsim > Mālik > Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Nawfal > ʿUrwah > Zaynab b. Abū Salamah > Um Salamah
body_en: I complained to the Messenger of Allah that I was sick, and he said: 'Perform Tawaf behind the people while you are riding.' So I performed Tawaf while the Messenger of Allah was praying beside the House, and reciting: 'The Tur (Mount), and by the Book Inscribed.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ وَالْحَارِثُ بْنُ مِسْكِينٍ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ

h2_title_en: Tawaf Of The One Who Has Entered Ihram For Umarh
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Manṣūr > Sufyān > ʿAmr > Ibn ʿUmar And Saʾalnāh
body_en:
I head Ibn Umar say - When we asked him about a man who came for Umrah, and perfomed Tawaf around the House, but did not perform Sai betwwen As-Safa and al-Marwah, could he be intimate with his wife? He said: 'When the Messenger of Allah came, he circumambulated seven times, and prayed two Rakahs behind the Maqam, and performed Sai between As-Safa and Al-Marwah. And you have the best examples in the Messenger of Allah.'" (Sahih) Chpater 143. So the people exited Ihram completely, such that intimacy with their wives became permissible. But the Messenger of Allahd did not exit Ihram, and he did not cut his hair until the Day of Sacrifice.

body: خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ صَلَّى الظُّهْرَ ثُمَّ رَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ فَلَمَّا اسْتَوَتْ بِهِ عَلَى الْبَيْدَاءِ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ جَمِيعًا فَأَهْلَلْنَا مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَكَّةَ وَطُفْنَا أَمَرَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يَحِلُّوا فَهَابَ الْقَوْمُ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ مَعِي الْهَدْىَ لأَحْلَلْتُ فَحَلَّ الْقَوْمُ حَتَّى حَلُّوا إِلَى النِّسَاءِ وَلَمْ يَحِلَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَلَمْ يُقَصِّرْ إِلَى يَوْمِ النَّحْرِ

h2_title_en: Tawaf Al-Qiran
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Manṣūr > Sufyān > Ayyūb b. Mūsá > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar Qaran al-Ḥaj And al-ʿUmrah Faṭāf Ṭawāf Wāḥid
body_en: This is what I saw the Messenger of Allah doing.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَرَنَ الْحَجَّ وَالْعُمْرَةَ فَطَافَ طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا
body: وَقَالَ هَكَذَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَفْعَلُهُ

h2_title_en: Tawaf Al-Qiran
title: null
chain_en: ʿAlī b. Maymūn al-Raqqī > Sufyān > Ayyūb al-Sakhtiyānī And ʾAyyūb b. Mūsá Waʾismāʿīl b. Umayyah Waʿubayd Allāh b. ʿUmar > Nāfiʿ
body_en: Abdullah bin Umar went out and he came to Dhul-Hulaifah he entered Ihram for Umrah. Then he traveled a short distance. Then he was afraid that he might be prevented from reaching the House. He said: 'If I am prevented I will do what the Messenger of Allah did.' He said: 'By Allah, Hajj is jut like Umrah; I ask you to bear witness that I have resolved to do Hajj with my Umrah.' He traveled on until he reached Qudaid, where he bought a Hadi. Then he came to Makkah, and circumambulated the House seven times, and performed Sai between As-Safa and Al-Marwah and said: 'This is what I saw the Messenger of Allah doing.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ الرَّقِّيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ وَأَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ قَالَ خَرَجَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ فَلَمَّا أَتَى ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ أَهَلَّ بِالْعُمْرَةِ فَسَارَ قَلِيلاً فَخَشِيَ أَنْ يُصَدَّ عَنِ الْبَيْتِ فَقَالَ
body: إِنْ صُدِدْتُ صَنَعْتُ كَمَا صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ مَا سَبِيلُ الْحَجِّ إِلاَّ سَبِيلُ الْعُمْرَةِ أُشْهِدُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَوْجَبْتُ مَعَ عُمْرَتِي حَجًّا فَسَارَ حَتَّى أَتَى قُدَيْدًا فَاشْتَرَى مِنْهَا هَدْيًا ثُمَّ قَدِمَ مَكَّةَ فَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ سَبْعًا وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ وَقَالَ هَكَذَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَعَلَ

h2_title_en: Tawaf Al-Qiran
title: null
chain_en: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Mahdī > Hāniʾ b. Ayyūb > Ṭāwus > Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh

chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَهْدِيٍّ أَخْبَرَنِي هَانِئُ بْنُ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ طَافَ طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا

h2_title_en: The Black Stone
title: null
chain_en: Ibrāhīm b. Yaʿqūb > Mūsá b. Dāwud > Ḥammād b. Salamah > ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib > Saʿīd b. Jubayr > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: The Black Stone is from Paradise.

h2_title_en: How To Perfom Tawaf Upon Arrival and Which Of Its Sides One Goes After Touching The Stone
h2_title: باب كَيْفَ يَطُوفُ أَوَّلَ مَا يَقْدَمُ وَعَلَى أَىِّ شِقَّيْهِ يَأْخُذُ إِذَا اسْتَلَمَ الْحَجَرَ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAbd al-Aʿlá b. Wāṣil b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlá > Yaḥyá b. Ādam > Sufyān > Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father > Jābir
body_en:
When the Messenger of Allah came to Makkah he entered the Masjid and touched the Stone, then he moved to his right and walked rapidly for three (rounds) and then walked (at a regular pace) for four. Then he came to the Maqam and said: 'And take you (people) the Maqam (place) of Ibrahim as a place of prayer and prayed two Rakahs with the Maqam between him and the House. Then he came to the Hosue after praying those two Rakahs and touched the Stone, then he went out to As-Safa." (Sahih) Chpater 150. h2_title_en: Walking Rapidly (Raml) In Hajj And 'Umrah
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad And ʿAbd al-Raḥman Āb.ā ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbd al-Ḥakam > Shuʿayb b. al-Layth from his father > Kathīr b. Farqad > Nāfiʿ
body_en: Abdullah bin Umar used to walk rapidly in three rounds of his Tawaf when he came for Hajj or Umrah, and walk (at a normal pace) in four. He said: "The Messenger of Allah used to do that."
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ ابْنَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَكَمِ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ اللَّيْثِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ كَانَ يَخُبُّ فِي طَوَافِهِ حِينَ يَقْدَمُ فِي حَجٍّ أَوْ عُمْرَةٍ ثَلاَثًا وَيَمْشِي أَرْبَعًا قَالَ
body: وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ

h2_title_en: Walking Rapidly From The Stone To The Stone
h2_title: باب الرَّمَلِ مِنَ الْحَجَرِ إِلَى الْحَجَرِ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Salamah And al-Ḥārith b. Miskīn > Ibn al-Qāsim > Mālik > Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father > Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
body_en: I saw the Messenger of Allah walking rapidly from the Stone to the Stone, until he had finished three circuits.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ وَالْحَارِثُ بْنُ مِسْكِينٍ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
body: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ رَمَلَ مِنَ الْحَجَرِ إِلَى الْحَجَرِ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَيْهِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَطْوَافٍ

h2_title_en: The Reason Why The Prophet Hastened When Performing Tawaf Around The House
h2_title: باب الْعِلَّةِ الَّتِي مِنْ أَجْلِهَا سَعَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِالْبَيْتِ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Sulaymān > Ḥammād b. Zayd > Ayyūb > Ibn Jubayr > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: When the Prophet and his Companions came to Makkah, the idolaters said: 'The fever of Yathrib has weakened them, and they have suffered a great deal because of it.' Allah informed His Prophet about that, so he told his Companions to walk rapidly, and to walk (at a normal pace) between the two corners, and the idolaters were on the side of the Stone. They said: 'They are stronger than such and such.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ عَنِ ابْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: لَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَأَصْحَابُهُ مَكَّةَ قَالَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ وَهَنَتْهُمْ حُمَّى يَثْرِبَ وَلَقَوْا مِنْهَا شَرًّا فَأَطْلَعَ اللَّهُ نَبِيَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلاَةُ وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ فَأَمَرَ أَصْحَابَهُ أَنْ يَرْمُلُوا وَأَنْ يَمْشُوا مَا بَيْنَ الرُّكْنَيْنِ وَكَانَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ مِنَ نَاحِيَةِ الْحِجْرِ فَقَالُوا لَهَؤُلاَءِ أَجْلَدُ مِنْ كَذَا

h2_title_en: The Reason Why The Prophet Hastened When Performing Tawaf Around The House
h2_title: باب الْعِلَّةِ الَّتِي مِنْ أَجْلِهَا سَعَى النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِالْبَيْتِ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Ḥammād > al-Zubayr b. ʿArabī
body_en: A man asked Ibn Umar about touching the Black Stone and he said: 'I saw the Messenger of Allah touching it and kissing it.' The man said: 'What if it is too crowded and I am overwhelmed?' Ibn Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, said: 'Leave your "what if" in Yemen! I saw the Messenger of Allah touching it and kissing it.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَرَبِيٍّ قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنِ اسْتِلاَمِ الْحَجَرِ فَقَالَ
body: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسْتَلِمُهُ وَيُقَبِّلُهُ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ زُحِمْتُ عَلَيْهِ أَوْ غُلِبْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ ؓ اجْعَلْ أَرَأَيْتَ بِالْيَمَنِ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسْتَلِمُهُ وَيُقَبِّلُهُ

h2_title_en: Touching The Two Corners In Every Tawaf
h2_title: باب اسْتِلاَمِ الرُّكْنَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ طَوَافٍ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. al-Muthanná > Yaḥyá > Ibn Abū Rawwād > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: the Prophet used to touch the Yemeni Corner and the Stone in earch Tawaf.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ يَسْتَلِمُ الرُّكْنَ الْيَمَانِيَ وَالْحَجَرَ فِي كُلِّ طَوَافٍ

h2_title_en: Touching The Two Corners In Every Tawaf
h2_title: باب اسْتِلاَمِ الرُّكْنَيْنِ فِي كُلِّ طَوَافٍ
title: null
chain_en: Ismāʿīl b. Masʿūd And Muḥammad b. al-Muthanná > Khālid > ʿUbaydullāh > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: The Prophet used to touch only the Stone and the Yemeni Corner. (Sahih) Chatper 157. Touching The Two Yemeni Corners
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ لاَ يَسْتَلِمُ إِلاَّ الْحَجَرَ وَالرُّكْنَ الْيَمَانِيَ

h2_title_en: Touching the two Yemeni corners
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > al-Layth > Ibn Shihāb > Sālim from his father
body_en: I did not see the Messenger of Allah touching any part of the House except the two Yemeni Corners.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ
body: لَمْ أَرَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَمْسَحُ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ إِلاَّ الرُّكْنَيْنِ الْيَمَانِيَيْنِ

h2_title_en: Not Touching The Other Two
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. al-ʿAlāʾ > Ibn Idrīs > ʿUbaydullāh And Ibn Jurayj And Mālik > al-Maqburī > ʿUbayd b. Jurayj
body_en:
I said to Ibn Umar: 'I see that you only touch these two Yemeni corners.' He said: 'I only saw the Messenger of Allah touch these two corners.'" h2_title_en: Not Touching The Other Two
title: null
chain_en: ʿUbaydullāh b. Saʿīd > Yaḥyá > ʿUbaydullāh > Nāfiʿ
body_en: Abdullah, may Allah be pleased with him, said: "I have not failed to touch these two corners since I saw the Messenger of Allah touching them, the Yemeni Corner and Black Stone, either when it is difficult or when it is easy.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ قَالَ قَالَ
body: عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ؓ مَا تَرَكْتُ اسْتِلاَمَ هَذَيْنِ الرُّكْنَيْنِ مُنْذُ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسْتَلِمُهُمَا الْيَمَانِيَ وَالْحَجَرَ فِي شِدَّةٍ وَلاَ رَخَاءٍ

h2_title_en: Not Touching The Other Two
title: null
chain_en: ʿImrān b. Mūsá > ʿAbd al-Wārith > Ayyūb > Nāfiʿ > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: Since I saw the Messenger of Allah touch it, I did not fail to touching the Stone whether it was easy or difficult.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عِمْرَانُ بْنُ مُوسَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
body: مَا تَرَكْتُ اسْتِلاَمَ الْحَجَرِ فِي رَخَاءٍ وَلاَ شِدَّةٍ مُنْذُ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسْتَلِمُهُ

h2_title_en: Touching The Corner With A Crookd-Dnded Stick
title: null
chain_en: Yūnus b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlá And Sulaymān b. Dāwud > Ibn Wahb > Yūnus > Ibn Shihāb > ʿUbaydullāh b. ʿAbdullāh > ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbbās
body_en: the Messenger of Allah circumambulated (the Kabah) during the Farewell Pilgrimage on a camel, touching the Corner with a crook-ended stick.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ طَافَ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ يَسْتَلِمُ الرُّكْنَ بِمِحْجَنٍ

h2_title_en: Pointing To The Corner
title: null
chain_en: Bishr b. Hilāl > ʿAbd al-Wārith > Khālid > ʿIkrimah > ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbbās
body_en: the Messenger of Allah used to circumambulate the House on his mount, and when he reached the Corner be pointed to it." (Sahih) Chpater 161. They Saying Of Allah, The Mighty And Sublimse: "Take Your Adornment To Every Masjid"
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ فَإِذَا انْتَهَى إِلَى الرُّكْنِ أَشَارَ إِلَيْهِ

h2_title_en: The saying of Allah, The Mighty And Sublime: "Take Your Adornment To Every Masjid"
h2_title: باب قَوْلِهِ ﷻ { خُذُوا زِينَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ }
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Bashhār > Muḥammad > Shuʿbah > Salamah > Muslim al-Baṭīn > Saʿīd b. Jubayr > Ibn ʿAbbās > Kānat al-Marʾah Taṭūf Bi-al-Bayt And Hī ʿUryānah
body_en: Women used to circumambulate the Kabah naked, saying: 'Today some, or all of it will appear And whatever appers I don't make is permissible.' Then the following was revealed: 'O Children of Adam! Take your adornment to every Masjid.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُسْلِمًا الْبَطِينَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: كَانَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ تَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ وَهِيَ عُرْيَانَةٌ تَقُولُ الْيَوْمَ يَبْدُو بَعْضُهُ أَوْ كُلُّهُ وَمَا بَدَا مِنْهُ فَلاَ أُحِلُّهُ قَالَ فَنَزَلَتْ { يَا بَنِي آدَمَ خُذُوا زِينَتَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَسْجِدٍ }

h2_title_en: The saying of Allah, The Mighty And Sublime: "Take Your Adornment To Every Masjid"

chain_en: Muḥammad b. Bashhār > Muḥammad And ʿUthmān b. ʿUmar > Shuʿbah > al-Mughīrah > al-Shaʿbī > al-Muḥarrar b. Abū Hurayrah from his father
body_en: I came with Ali bin Abi Talib when the Messenger of Allah sent him to the people of Makkah with news of the dissolution of treaty obligations." He said: "How did you announced that no one would enter Paradise but a believing soul, no one was to circumambulate the House naked: whoever had a treaty with the Messenger of Allah, then for its period, or, it extended to four months, and when four months had passed, and that Allah is free from (all) obligations to the idolaters and so is His Messenger. No idolater was to perform Hajj after this year. I kept on announcing it until my vice grew hoarse.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنِ الْمُحَرَّرِ بْنِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ
body: جِئْتُ مَعَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ حِينَ بَعَثَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ بِبَرَاءَةَ قَالَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تُنَادُونَ قَالَ كُنَّا نُنَادِي إِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلاَّ نَفْسٌ مُؤْمِنَةٌ وَلاَ يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ عُرْيَانٌ وَمَنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَهْدٌ فَأَجَلُهُ أَوْ أَمَدُهُ إِلَى أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ فَإِذَا مَضَتِ الأَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بَرِيءٌ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ وَرَسُولُهُ وَلاَ يَحُجُّ بَعْدَ الْعَامِ مُشْرِكٌ فَكُنْتُ أُنَادِي حَتَّى صَحِلَ صَوْتِي

h2_title_en: What To Say After The Two Rakahs Of Tawaf
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbd al-Ḥakam > Shuʿayb > al-Layth > Ibn al-Hād > Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father > Jābir
body_en: The Messenger of Allah circumambulated the House seven times, walking rapidly (Raml) in the three, and walking (at a regular pace) for four. Then he stood near the Maqam and prayed two Rakahs. Then he recited: 'And take you the Maqam (Place) of Ibrahim as a place of prayer, raising his voice, so that the people would hear. Then he went (to perform Sai) and said: 'We will start with that with which Allah started.' So he started with As-Safa, climbing up, until he could see the House, and he said three times: 'La ilaha illallah, Wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa huwaala kulli shayin qadir (There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone with no partner or associate, His is the dominion and to Him be praise, He gives life and death, and He has power over all things).' Then exclaimed Allah's greatness, then he supplicated as much as was decreed for him. Then he came down walking until he reached level ground at the bottom of the valley. Then he hastened until the ground began to rise. Then he walked until he came to Al-Marwah and clime dup it, and when he could see the House he said: 'La ilaha illallah, Wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa huwaala kulli shayin qadir (There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone with no partner or associate, His is the dominion and to Him be praise, He gives life and death, and He has power over all things).' He said that three times, then he remembered Allah and glorified and praised Him, then he supplicated there for as long as Allah willed. And he did that until he finished Sai.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ
body: طَافَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْبَيْتِ سَبْعًا رَمَلَ مِنْهَا ثَلاَثًا وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا ثُمَّ قَامَ عِنْدَ الْمَقَامِ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ { وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى } وَرَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ يُسْمِعُ النَّاسَ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَاسْتَلَمَ ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ فَقَالَ نَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهَا حَتَّى بَدَا لَهُ الْبَيْتُ فَقَالَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ فَكَبَّرَ اللَّهَ وَحَمِدَهُ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَا قُدِّرَ لَهُ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ مَاشِيًا حَتَّى تَصَوَّبَتْ قَدَمَاهُ فِي بَطْنِ الْمَسِيلِ فَسَعَى حَتَّى صَعِدَتْ قَدَمَاهُ ثُمَّ مَشَى حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَرْوَةَ فَصَعِدَ فِيهَا ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُ الْبَيْتُ فَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ قَالَ ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ اللَّهَ وَسَبَّحَهُ وَحَمِدَهُ ثُمَّ دَعَا عَلَيْهَا بِمَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَعَلَ هَذَا حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنَ الطَّوَافِ

body_en: And take you the Maqam (place) of Ibrahim as a place of prayer." And prayed two Rakʿahs with the Maqam between him and the Kaʿbah. Then he touched the Corner, then he went out and said: 'As-Safa and Al-Marwah are two of the symbols of Allah. We will start with that with which Allah started.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ طَافَ سَبْعًا رَمَلَ ثَلاَثًا وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا ثُمَّ قَرَأَ { وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى } فَصَلَّى سَجْدَتَيْنِ وَجَعَلَ الْمَقَامَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْكَعْبَةِ ثُمَّ اسْتَلَمَ الرُّكْنَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ فَابْدَءُوا بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ

body_en: I recited to Aishah: 'So it is not a sin on him who performs Hajj or Umrah (Pilgrimage) of the House to Perform the going Tawaf) between them (as-Safa and Al-Marwah) "I said: 'I do not care if I do not go between tham?' She said: 'What a bad thing you have said!' People at the time of the Jahiliyyah used not to go between them, but when Islam came and the Quran was revealed: 'Verily, As-Safa and Al-Marwah are of the symols of Allah, the Messenger of Allah went between them, and we did that with him, and thus it became part of Hajj.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ قَالَ

chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿUthmān from my father > Shuʿayb > al-Zuhrī > ʿUrwah > Saʾalt ʿĀʾishah > Qawl Allāh ʿAz And Jal Falā Junāḥ ʿAlayh > Yaṭṭawwaf Bihimā Fawālllah Mā > Aḥad Junāḥ > Lā Yaṭūf Bi-al-Ṣṣafā Wa-al-Marwah > ʿĀʾishah Biʾsamā Qult Yā Ibn Ukhtī In Hadhih al-Āyah
body_en: I asked Aishah about the words of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime: 'So it sin not a sin on him who perform Hajj or Umrah (Pilgrimage) of the House (the Kabah at Makkah) to perform the going (Tawaf) between them (as-Safa and Al-Marwah) and (I said): 'By Allah, there is no sin on anyone if he does not go between As-Safa and Al-Marwa.' Aishah said: 'What a bad thing you said, O son of my brother! If this Ayah was as you have interpreted it, there would be no sin on a person if he did not go between them. But it was revealed concering the Ansar. Before they accepted Islam, they sued to enter Ihram for the false goddess Manat whom they used to worship at Al-Mushallal. Whoever enter Ihram for her would refrain from going between As-Safa and Al-Marwah. When they asked the Messenger of Allah about that, Allah, the Might and Sublime, revealed: 'Verily As-Safa and Al-Marwah (Two mountains in Makkah) are of the Symbols of Allah. So it is not a sin on him who performs Hajj or Urmrah (Pilgrimage) of the House (the Kabah at Makkah) to perform the going (Tawaf) between them (As-Safa and Al-Marwah). Then the Messenger of Allah enjoined going between them so no one has the right to refrain from going between them.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ

h2_title_en: Remembrance and supplication Atop As-Safa
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbd al-Ḥakam > Shuʿayb > al-Layth > Ibn al-Hād > Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father > Jābir
body_en: The Messenger of Allah circumambulated the House seven times, walking rapidly in three circuits and walking (at a normal pace)b in three. Then he stood at the Maqam (place) of Ibrahim as a place of prayer, raising his voice so that the people could hear. Then he went and touched the Black Stone and went (to perform Sai) and said: 'We will start with that with which Allah started.' So he started with As-Safa, climbing up until he could see the House and he said three times: ''La ilaha illallah, Wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa huwaala kulli shayin qadir (There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone with no partner or associate, His is the dominion and to Him be praise, He gives life and death, and He has power over all things).' Then exclaimed Allah's greatness and praised Him, then he supplicated as much as was decreed for him. Then he came down walking, until he reached level ground at the bottom of the valley. Then he hastened until the ground began to rise. Then he walked until he came to Al-Marwah and climbed up it, and when he could see the house he said: 'La ilaha illallah, Wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa huwaala kulli shayin qadir (There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone with no partner or associate, His is the dominion and to Him be praise, He gives life and death, and He has power over all things).' He said that three times, then he remembered Allah, and glorified and praised Him, then he supplicated there for as long as Allah willed. And he did that until he had finished Sai.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ { عَبْدِ } الْحَكَمِ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ
body: طَافَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِالْبَيْتِ سَبْعًا رَمَلَ مِنْهَا ثَلاَثًا وَمَشَى أَرْبَعًا ثُمَّ قَامَ عِنْدَ الْمَقَامِ فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَقَرَأَ { وَاتَّخِذُوا مِنْ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ مُصَلًّى } وَرَفَعَ صَوْتَهُ يُسْمِعُ النَّاسَ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَاسْتَلَمَ ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ فَقَالَ نَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللَّهُ بِهِ فَبَدَأَ بِالصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهَا حَتَّى بَدَا لَهُ الْبَيْتُ وَقَالَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ وَكَبَّرَ اللَّهَ وَحَمِدَهُ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَا قُدِّرَ لَهُ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ مَاشِيًا حَتَّى تَصَوَّبَتْ قَدَمَاهُ فِي بَطْنِ الْمَسِيلِ فَسَعَى حَتَّى صَعِدَتْ قَدَمَاهُ ثُمَّ مَشَى حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَرْوَةَ فَصَعِدَ فِيهَا ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُ الْبَيْتُ فَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ قَالَ ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ اللَّهَ وَسَبَّحَهُ وَحَمِدَهُ ثُمَّ دَعَا عَلَيْهَا بِمَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَعَلَ هَذَا حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنَ الطَّوَافِ

h2_title_en: Sa 'I Between As-Safa And Al-Marwah On A Mount
h2_title: باب الطَّوَافِ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ عَلَى الرَّاحِلَةِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿImrān b. Yazīd > Shuʿayb > Ibn Jurayj > Abū al-Zubayr > Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
body_en: During the Farewell Pilgrimage the Prophet circumambulated the House and went between As-Safa and Al-Marwah on his mount so that the people could see him and he could see them, and they could ask him questions, and the people crowded around him.
chain: أَخْبَرَنِي عِمْرَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا شُعَيْبٌ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ
body: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ طَافَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ لِيَرَاهُ النَّاسُ وَلِيُشْرِفَ وَلِيَسْأَلُوهُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ غَشُوهُ

h2_title_en: Walking Between Them
title: null
chain_en: Maḥmūd b. Ghaylān > Bishr b. al-Sarī > Sufyān > ʿAṭāʾ b. al-Sāʾib > Kathīr b. Jumhān > Raʾayt Ibn ʿUmar Yamshī Bayn al-Ṣafā And al-Marwah
body_en: I saw Ibn Umar walking between As-Safa and Al-Marwah. He said: 'I am walking because I saw the Messenger of Allah Walking, and I hasten because I saw the Messenger of Allah hasten.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ جُمْهَانَ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ يَمْشِي بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ فَقَالَ
body: إِنْ أَمْشِي فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَمْشِي وَإِنْ أَسْعَى فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسْعَى

h2_title_en: Walking Between Them
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Rāfiʿ > ʿAbd al-Razzāq > al-Thawrī > ʿAbd al-Karīm al-Jazarī > Saʿīd b. Jubayr > Raʾayt Ibn ʿUmar And Dhakar > Ilā
body_en: I saw Ibn Umar and he mentioned something similar, except he said: "and I am an old man.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا الثَّوْرِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ الْجَزَرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ وَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ إِلاَّ
body: أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَأَنَا شَيْخٌ كَبِيرٌ

h2_title_en: Walking Rapidly (Raml) Between Them
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Manṣūr > Sufyān > Ṣadaqah b. Yasār > al-Zuhrī
body_en:
They asked Ibn Umar: 'Did you see the Messenger of Allah walk rapidly between As-Safa and Al-Marwah?' He said: 'He was among a group of people and they walked rapidly, and I think they went at the same pace as him.'" h2_title_en: Sa'I At The Bottom Of The Valley
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Ḥammād > Budayl > al-Mughīrah b. Ḥakīm > Ṣafiyyah b. Shaybah > Āmraʾah
body_en: I saw the Messenger of Allah hastening at the bottom of the valley and he said: "The river bed should not be crossed except with vigor." (Sahih) Chpater 178. The Place Where One Should Walk
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ بُدَيْلٍ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ قَالَتْ
body: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَسْعَى فِي بَطْنِ الْمَسِيلِ وَيَقُولُ لاَ يُقْطَعُ الْوَادِي إِلاَّ شَدًّا

h2_title_en: The Place Where One Should Walk
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Salamah And al-Ḥārith b. Miskīn > Ibn al-Qāsim > Mālik > Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father > Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
body_en: when the Messenger of Allah came down from As-Safa he would walk until he reached the bottom of the valley, then he would hasten until he came out of it.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ وَالْحَارِثُ بْنُ مِسْكِينٍ قِرَاءَةً عَلَيْهِ وَأَنَا أَسْمَعُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْقَاسِمِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ؓ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَانَ إِذَا نَزَلَ مِنَ الصَّفَا مَشَى حَتَّى إِذَا انْصَبَّتْ قَدَمَاهُ فِي بَطْنِ الْوَادِي سَعَى حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ مِنْهُ

h2_title_en: The Place Where One Should Hasten
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. al-Muthanná > Sufyān > Jaʿfar from his father > Jābir
body_en: When the Messenger of Allah reached level ground at the bottom of the valley, he would hasten until he came out of it.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ
body: لَمَّا تَصَوَّبَتْ قَدَمَا رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي بَطْنِ الْوَادِي رَمَلَ حَتَّى خَرَجَ مِنْهُ

h2_title_en: The Place Where One Should Hasten
title: null
chain_en: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm > Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd > Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from my father > Jābir
body_en: the Messenger of Allah came down from As-Safa until he reached level round in the valley, then he hastened (Ramel) until (the ground) rouse, then he walked.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرٌ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَزَلَ يَعْنِي عَنِ الصَّفَا حَتَّى إِذَا انْصَبَّتْ قَدَمَاهُ فِي الْوَادِي رَمَلَ حَتَّى إِذَا صَعِدَ مَشَى

h2_title_en: The Place Where One Should Stand On Al-Marwah
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. ʿAbd al-Ḥakam > Shuʿayb > al-Layth > Ibn al-Hād > Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father
body_en: the Messenger of Allah came to Al-Marwah and climbed up until he could see the House, then he said: "La ilaha illallah, Wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa huwaala kulli shayin qadir (There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone with no partner or associate, His is the dominion and to Him be praise, He gives life and death, and He has power over all things)." He said that three times, then he remembered Allah, and glorified and praised Him, then he supplicated there for as long as Allah willed. And he did that until he had finished Sai."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا اللَّيْثُ عَنِ ابْنِ الْهَادِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
body: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَتَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْمَرْوَةَ فَصَعِدَ فِيهَا ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُ الْبَيْتُ فَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ قَالَ ذَلِكَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ اللَّهَ وَسَبَّحَهُ وَحَمِدَهُ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِمَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَعَلَ هَذَا حَتَّى فَرَغَ مِنَ الطَّوَافِ

h2_title_en: The Takbir Atop It (Al-Marwah)
title: null
chain_en: ʿAlī b. Ḥujr > Ismāʿīl > Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from his father > Jābir
body_en: La ilaha illallah, Wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu, wa huwaala kulli shayin qadir (There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone with no partner or associate, His is the dominion and to Him be praise, He gives life and death, and He has power over all things)." Then he walked until he reached level ground, then he hastened until the ground began to rise. Then he walked until he came to Al-Marwah, and he did the same there as he had at As-Safa, until he had finished his Sai.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ ذَهَبَ إِلَى الصَّفَا فَرَقِيَ عَلَيْهَا حَتَّى بَدَا لَهُ الْبَيْتُ ثُمَّ وَحَّدَ اللَّهَ ﷻ وَكَبَّرَهُ وَقَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ثُمَّ مَشَى حَتَّى إِذَا انْصَبَّتْ قَدَمَاهُ سَعَى حَتَّى إِذَا صَعِدَتْ قَدَمَاهُ مَشَى حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَرْوَةَ فَفَعَلَ عَلَيْهَا كَمَا فَعَلَ عَلَى الصَّفَا حَتَّى قَضَى طَوَافَهُ

h2_title_en: How Many Times Should Those Performing Hajj Al-Qiran And Hajj Tamattu Go Between As-Safa and Al-Marwah?
h2_title: باب كَمْ طَوَافُ الْقَارِنِ وَالْمُتَمَتِّعِ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ}
title: null
chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿAlī > Yaḥyá > Ibn Jurayj > Abū al-Zubayr > Jābir
body_en: The Prophet and his Companions only performed Sai between As-Safa and Al-Marwah once.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ
body: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا يَقُولُ لَمْ يَطُفِ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ وَأَصْحَابُهُ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ إِلاَّ طَوَافًا وَاحِدًا

h2_title_en: Where Should The Pilgrim Performing 'Umrah Cut His Hair?
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. al-Muthanná > Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd > Ibn Jurayj > al-Ḥasan b. Muslim > Ṭāwus > Ibn ʿAbbās > Muʿāwiyah > Qaṣṣar
body_en: he cut the hair of the Prophet with the edge of an arrow during his Umrah at Al-Marwah.

h2_title_en: What Should A Person Do Who Entered Ihram For Hajj While Having Brought A Hadi With Him
h2_title: باب مَا يَفْعَلُ مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ وَأَهْدَى
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Rāfiʿ > Yaḥyá / Ibn Ādam > Sufyān Wahū Ibn ʿUyaynah > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. al-Qāsim from his father > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: We went out with the Messenger of Allah with no intention but Hajj. When he had circumambulated the Hosue and performed Sai between As-Safa and Al-Marwah, he said: 'Whoever has a Hadi with him, let him remain in Ihram, and whoever does not have a Hadi with him, let him exit Ihram.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى وَهُوَ ابْنُ آدَمَ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ لاَ نُرَى إِلاَّ الْحَجَّ قَالَتْ فَلَمَّا أَنْ طَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ وَبَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ قَالَ مَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ هَدْىٌ فَلْيُقِمْ عَلَى إِحْرَامِهِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ هَدْىٌ فَلْيَحْلِلْ

h2_title_en: What Should A Person Do Who Entered Ihram For 'Umrah While Having Brought A Hadi With Him?
h2_title: باب مَا يَفْعَلُ مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَأَهْدَى
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Ḥātim > Sūwayd > ʿAbdullāh > Yūnus > Ibn Shihāb > ʿUrwah > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: We set out with the Messenger of Allah for the Farewell Pilgrimage. Some of us entered Ihram for Hajj and some of us entered Ihram for Umrah and brought along a Hadi. The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever entered Ihram for Umrah and did not bring Hadi, let him exit Ihram. And whoever entered Ihram for Umrah and did bring a Hadi, let him not exit Ihra. Whoever entered Ihram for Hajj let him complete his Hajj.'" Aishah said "And I was one of those who had entered Ihram for Umrah.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا سُوَيْدٌ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي حَجَّةِ الْوَدَاعِ فَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ وَمِنَّا مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَأَهْدَى فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَلَمْ يُهْدِ فَلْيَحْلِلْ وَمَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ فَأَهْدَى فَلاَ يَحِلَّ وَمَنْ أَهَلَّ بِحَجَّةٍ فَلْيُتِمَّ حَجَّهُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَكُنْتُ مِمَّنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ

h2_title_en: What Should A Person Do Who Entered Ihram For 'Umrah While Having Brought A Hadi With Him?
h2_title: باب مَا يَفْعَلُ مَنْ أَهَلَّ بِعُمْرَةٍ وَأَهْدَى
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAbdullāh b. al-Mubārak > Abū Hishām > Wuhayb b. Khālid > Manṣūr b. ʿAbd al-Raḥman from his mother > Asmāʾ b. Abū Bakr
body_en: We came with the Messenger of Allah reciting the Talbiyah for Hajj. When we drew close to Makkah, the Messenger of Alla said: 'Whoever does not have a Hadi with him, let him exit Ihram. Whoever has a Hadi with him, let him remain in Ihram.' Az-Zubair had a Hadi with him so he remained in Ihram, but I did not have a Hadi with me so I exited Ihram, put on my some of my perfume. Then I sat down with As-Zubair and he said: "Go away from me.' I said: 'Are you afraid that I am going to jump on you?'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِشَامٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أُمِّهِ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَتْ
body: قَدِمْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مُهِلِّينَ بِالْحَجِّ فَلَمَّا دَنَوْنَا مِنْ مَكَّةَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُ هَدْىٌ فَلْيَحْلِلْ وَمَنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ هَدْىٌ فَلْيُقِمْ عَلَى إِحْرَامِهِ قَالَتْ وَكَانَ مَعَ الزُّبَيْرِ هَدْىٌ فَأَقَامَ عَلَى إِحْرَامِهِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ مَعِي هَدْىٌ فَأَحْلَلْتُ فَلَبِسْتُ ثِيَابِي وَتَطَيَّبْتُ مِنْ طِيبِي ثُمَّ جَلَسْتُ إِلَى الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَالَ اسْتَأْخِرِي عَنِّي فَقُلْتُ أَتَخْشَى أَنْ أَثِبَ عَلَيْكَ

h2_title_en: Khutbah Before The Day Of At-Tarwiyah
title: null
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > Abū Qurrah Mūsá b. Ṭāriq > Ibn Jurayj > ʿAbdullāh b. ʿUthmān b. Khuthaym > Abū al-Zubayr > Jābir > al-Nabī ﷺ
body_en: when the Prophet came back from the Umrah of Al-Jirranah, he sent Abu Bakr to lead the Hajj. We wnet the him until, when he was in Al-Urj, the Iqamah for Subh was said, and he stood up to say the Takbir while he heard the grunting of a camel behind him, and he did not say the Takbir. He said: "This is the grunting of the camel of the Messenger of Allah has had second thoughts about the Hajj, and may be he is here, and we will pray with him." But it was 'Ali on the camel. Abu Bakr said to him: "(Have you come) as a leader or as messenger?" He said: "No, as a messenger, sent by the Messenger of Allah with a declaration of innocence to recite it to the people in the stations of Hajj. So we came to makkah and one day before the day of At-Tarwiyah Abu Bakr, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and addressed the people telling them about their rituals. When he finished, Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. Then we went out with hm and on the day of Arafat. Abu Bakr stood up and addressed people, telling them about rituals. When he finished, Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. Then on the day of Sacrifice, we departed (Ifadah) and when Abu Bakr came back, eh addressed the people, telling them about their departure (Ifadah), sacrifice and rituals. When he finished, Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. On the first day of An-Nafr (The 12th of Dhul-Hijjah), Abu Bakr stood up and addressed the people, telling them how to offer their sacrifice and how to stone the Jamrat, and teaching them their rituals. When he had finished, "Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, stood up and recited the declaration of innocence to the people until he finished it. (Daif) Abu Abdur-Rahman (An-Nasai) said: Ibn Khuthaim is not strong in Hadith, and I only narrated this so it would not be considered to be from Ibn Juraij from Abu Az-Zubai. And we did not write it except from Ishaq bin Rahuyah bin Ibrahm. And yahya bin Saeed Al-Qattan did not abandon the narrations of Ibn Khuthaim, or dod Abdur-Rahamn. However, Ali bin Al-Madini said: "Ibn Khuthaim is Munkar in Hadith," and Ali bin Al-Madini is more knowledgeable of Hadith.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى أَبِي قُرَّةَ مُوسَى بْنِ طَارِقٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ خُثَيْمٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ حِينَ رَجَعَ مِنْ عُمْرَةِ الْجِعِرَّانَةِ بَعَثَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ عَلَى الْحَجِّ فَأَقْبَلْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِالْعَرْجِ ثَوَّبَ بِالصُّبْحِ ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى لِيُكَبِّرَ فَسَمِعَ الرُّغْوَةَ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ فَوَقَفَ عَلَى التَّكْبِيرِ فَقَالَ هَذِهِ رُغْوَةُ نَاقَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْجَدْعَاءِ لَقَدْ بَدَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي الْحَجِّ فَلَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَكُونَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَنُصَلِّيَ مَعَهُ فَإِذَا عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَمِيرٌ أَمْ رَسُولٌ قَالَ لاَ بَلْ رَسُولٌ أَرْسَلَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِبَرَاءَةَ أَقْرَؤُهَا عَلَى النَّاسِ فِي مَوَاقِفِ الْحَجِّ فَقَدِمْنَا مَكَّةَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ قَبْلَ التَّرْوِيَةِ بِيَوْمٍ قَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ؓ فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَحَدَّثَهُمْ عَنْ مَنَاسِكِهِمْ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ قَامَ عَلِيٌّ ؓ فَقَرَأَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بَرَاءَةَ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا ثُمَّ خَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ قَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَحَدَّثَهُمْ عَنْ مَنَاسِكِهِمْ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ قَامَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَرَأَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بَرَاءَةَ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا ثُمَّ كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ فَأَفَضْنَا فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ خَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَحَدَّثَهُمْ عَنْ إِفَاضَتِهِمْ وَعَنْ نَحْرِهِمْ وَعَنْ مَنَاسِكِهِمْ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَامَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَرَأَ عَلَى النَّاسِ بَرَاءَةَ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ النَّفْرِ الأَوَّلُ قَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ فَحَدَّثَهُمْ كَيْفَ يَنْفِرُونَ وَكَيْفَ يَرْمُونَ فَعَلَّمَهُمْ مَنَاسِكَهُمْ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَامَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَرَأَ بَرَاءَةَ عَلَى النَّاسِ حَتَّى خَتَمَهَا قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ خُثَيْمٍ لَيْسَ بِالْقَوِيِّ فِي الْحَدِيثِ وَإِنَّمَا أَخْرَجْتُ هَذَا لِئَلاَّ يُجْعَلَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ وَمَا كَتَبْنَاهُ إِلاَّ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَيَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ لَمْ يَتْرُكْ حَدِيثَ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ وَلاَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِلاَّ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْمَدِينِيِّ قَالَ ابْنُ خُثَيْمٍ مُنْكَرُ الْحَدِيثِ وَكَأَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْمَدِينِيِّ خُلِقَ لِلْحَدِيثِ

h2_title_en: When Should The Pilgrim Who Is Perfoming Hajj At-Tamattu' Enter Ihram For Hajj?
title: null
chain_en: Ismāʿīl b. Masʿūd > Khālid > ʿAbd al-Malik > ʿAṭāʾ > Jābir
body_en: We came with the Messenger of Allah on the fourth day of Dhul-Hijjah. The prophet said: 'Exit Ihram and make it Umrah.' We were distressed and upset by that. News of that reached the Messenger of Allah and he said: 'O people, exit Ihram. Were if not for the Hadi that I brought with me, I would have done what you are doing.' So we exited Ihram, and had intercourse with our wives, ad we did everything that the non-Muhrim does until the day of At-Tarwiyah, when we put Makkah behind us (When we headed for Mina) and entered Ihram for Hajj.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ
body: قَدِمْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ لأَرْبَعٍ مَضَيْنَ مِنْ ذِي الْحِجَّةِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ أَحِلُّوا وَاجْعَلُوهَا عُمْرَةً فَضَاقَتْ بِذَلِكَ صُدُورُنَا وَكَبُرَ عَلَيْنَا فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَحِلُّوا فَلَوْلاَ الْهَدْىُ الَّذِي مَعِي لَفَعَلْتُ مِثْلَ الَّذِي تَفْعَلُونَ فَأَحْلَلْنَا حَتَّى وَطِئْنَا النِّسَاءَ وَفَعَلْنَا مَا يَفْعَلُ الْحَلاَلُ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ التَّرْوِيَةِ وَجَعَلْنَا مَكَّةَ بِظَهْرٍ لَبَّيْنَا بِالْحَجِّ

h2_title_en: What Was Mentioned Concerning Mina

body_en:
Abdullah bin Umar came to me when I had stopped beneath a large tree on the way to Makkah. He said: 'Why did you stop beneath this tree?' I said: 'Because of its shade.' Abdullah said: 'The Messenger of Allah said: If you are between the two mountains of Mina - and he pointed with his hand toward the east - there is a valley there called As-Surrabah according to the narration of Al-Harith: Called As-Surar - in which there is large tree beneath which seventy prophets were born." h2_title_en: Leaving Mina (In The Morning) For 'Arafat
h2_title: باب الْغُدُوِّ مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Yaḥyá b. Ḥabīb b. ʿArabī > Ḥammād > Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd al-Anṣārī > ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Salamah > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: We left Mina with the Messenger of Allah for AArafat, and some of us were reciting the Talbiyah and some reciting the Takbir.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عَرَبِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
body: غَدَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَةَ فَمِنَّا الْمُلَبِّي وَمِنَّا الْمُكَبِّرُ

h2_title_en: Leaving Mina (In The Morning) For 'Arafat
h2_title: باب الْغُدُوِّ مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm al-Dawraqī > Hushaym > Yaḥyá > ʿAbdullāh b. Abū Salamah > Ibn ʿUmar
body_en: We left for Arafat with the Messenger of Allah, and some of us were reciting the Talbiyah and some reciting the Takbir.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ
body: غَدَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ فَمِنَّا الْمُلَبِّي وَمِنَّا الْمُكَبِّرُ

h2_title_en: The Takbir On The Way To 'Arafat
h2_title: باب التَّكْبِيرِ فِي الْمَسِيرِ إِلَى عَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > al-Mulāʾī / Abū Nuʿaym al-Faḍl b. Dukayn > Mālik
body_en: When we were leaving Mina for Arafat, I said to Anas: 'What did you do for the Talbiyah with the Messenger of Allah on this day?' He said 'Those who recited the Talbiyah did so, and no one criticized them, and those who recited the Takbir did so, and no one criticized them.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا الْمُلاَئِيُّ يَعْنِي أَبَا نُعَيْمٍ الْفَضْلَ بْنَ دُكَيْنٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ قَالَ
body: قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ وَنَحْنُ غَادِيَانِ مِنْ مِنًى إِلَى عَرَفَاتٍ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ فِي التَّلْبِيَةِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ قَالَ كَانَ الْمُلَبِّي يُلَبِّي فَلاَ يُنْكَرُ عَلَيْهِ وَيُكَبِّرُ الْمُكَبِّرُ فَلاَ يُنْكَرُ عَلَيْهِ

h2_title_en: Talbiyah On The Way
title: null
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > ʿAbdullāh b. Rajāʾ > Mūsá b. ʿUqbah
body_en: I said to Anas on the morning of Arafat: 'What do you say about the Talbiyah on this day?' I said: 'I walked this path with the Messenger of Allah and his Companions. Some of them recited the Talbiyah and some recited the Takbir, and none of them denounced any other.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَجَاءٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَهُوَ الثَّقَفِيُّ قَالَ
body: قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ غَدَاةَ عَرَفَةَ مَا تَقُولُ فِي التَّلْبِيَةِ فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ قَالَ سِرْتُ هَذَا الْمَسِيرَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَكَانَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُهِلُّ وَمِنْهُمُ الْمُكَبِّرُ فَلاَ يُنْكِرُ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ

h2_title_en: What Was Narrated Concerning The Day Of Arafat
h2_title: باب مَا ذُكِرَ فِي يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > ʿAbdullāh b. Idrīs from his father > Qays b. Muslim > Ṭāriq b. Shihāb
body_en: A Jew said to ʿUmar: "If this Verse had been revealed to us, we would have taken it as a festival (Eid): 'This day, I have perfected your religion for you.'" Umar said: "I know the day when it was revealed and the night on which it was revealed: a Friday night when we were with Messenger of Allah in Arafat."
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ طَارِقِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ قَالَ
body: يَهُودِيٌّ لِعُمَرَ لَوْ عَلَيْنَا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ لاَتَّخَذْنَاهُ عِيدًا { الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ } قَالَ عُمَرُ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ الْيَوْمَ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَتْ فِيهِ وَاللَّيْلَةَ الَّتِي أُنْزِلَتْ لَيْلَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَنَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ بِعَرَفَاتٍ

h2_title_en: What Was Narrated Concerning The Day Of Arafat
h2_title: باب مَا ذُكِرَ فِي يَوْمِ عَرَفَةَ
title: null
part: يباهي بهم الملائكة فيقول ما أراد هؤلاء
chain_en: ʿĪsá b. Ibrāhīm > Ibn Wahb > Makhramah from his father > Yūnus > Ibn al-Musayyab > ʿĀʾishah
body_en:
There is no day on which Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, frees more of his slaves, male and female, from the fire, than the day of Arafah. h2_title_en: Leaving (In The Afternoo) on The Day Of 'Arafat
title: null
chain_en: Yūnus b. ʿAbd al-Aʿlá > Ashhab > Mālik > Ibn Shihāb > Sālim b. ʿAbdullāh > Katab ʿAbd al-Malik b. Marwān > al-Ḥajjāj b. Yūsuf Yaʾmuruh
body_en: Abdul Malik bin Marwan wrote to Al-Hajjaj bin Yusuf telling him not to go against Ibn Umar with regard to the Hajj. On the day of Arafat, Ibn Umar came to him when the sun had passed its zenith, and I was with him, and shouted near his cotton tent: 'Where is he?' Al-Hajjaj came out to him, wearing a wrap dyed with safflower. He said: 'What is the matter, O Abu Abdur Rahman?' He said: 'We have to move on if you want to follow Sunnah.' He said to him: 'At this hour?' He said: 'Yes.' He said: 'I will pour some water over my self (have a bath) then I will come out to you.' So he waited until he came, then he walked between my father and me, I said: 'If you want to follow the Sunnah, then deliver a short Khutbah and hasten to stand (in Arafat).' He started to look at Ibn Umar so that he could hear that, and when Ibn Umar noticed that he said: 'He is speaking the truth.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَشْهَبُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكٌ أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ كَتَبَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ إِلَى الْحَجَّاجِ بْنِ يُوسُفَ يَأْمُرُهُ أَنْ لاَ يُخَالِفَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فِي أَمْرِ الْحَجِّ فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ عَرَفَةَ جَاءَهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ حِينَ زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَأَنَا مَعَهُ فَصَاحَ عِنْدَ سُرَادِقِهِ أَيْنَ هَذَا فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ الْحَجَّاجُ وَعَلَيْهِ مِلْحَفَةٌ مُعَصْفَرَةٌ فَقَالَ
body: لَهُ مَا لَكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ الرَّوَاحَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تُرِيدُ السُّنَّةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ نَعَمْ فَقَالَ أُفِيضُ عَلَىَّ مَاءً ثُمَّ أَخْرُجُ إِلَيْكَ فَانْتَظَرَهُ حَتَّى خَرَجَ فَسَارَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ أَبِي فَقُلْتُ إِنْ كُنْتَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُصِيبَ السُّنَّةَ فَاقْصُرِ الْخُطْبَةَ وَعَجِّلِ الْوُقُوفَ فَجَعَلَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ كَيْمَا يَسْمَعَ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ قَالَ صَدَقَ

h2_title_en: The Talbiyah At 'Arfat
title: null
chain_en: Aḥmad b. ʿUthmān b. Ḥakīm al-Awdī > Khālid b. Makhlad > ʿAlī b. Ṣāliḥ > Maysarah b. Ḥabīb > al-Minhāl b. ʿAmr > Saʿīd b. Jubayr
body_en: I was with Ibn Abbas in Arafat and he said: 'Why do I not hear the people reciting Talbiyah?' I said: They are afraid of Muawiyah.' So Ibn Abbas went out of his tent and said: "Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik, Labbaik! They are only forsaking the Sunnah out of hatred for Ali.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ حَكِيمٍ الأَوْدِيُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ صَالِحٍ عَنْ مَيْسَرَةَ بْنِ حَبِيبٍ عَنِ الْمِنْهَالِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ كُنْتُ مَعَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ بِعَرَفَاتٍ فَقَالَ مَا لِي لاَ أَسْمَعُ النَّاسَ يُلَبُّونَ قُلْتُ يَخَافُونَ مِنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ فَخَرَجَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ مِنْ فُسْطَاطِهِ فَقَالَ
body: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ فَإِنَّهُمْ قَدْ تَرَكُوا السُّنَّةَ مِنْ بُغْضِ عَلِيٍّ

h2_title_en: Joining Zuhr And 'Asr In 'Arafat
h2_title: باب الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ بِعَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Ismāʿīl b. Masʿūd > Khālid > Shuʿbah > Sulaymān > ʿUmārah b. ʿUmayr > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd > ʿAbdullāh
body_en: The Messenger of Allah used to offer prayers at their proper time except in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah) and Arafat.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ عَنْ خَالِدٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ
body: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُصَلِّي الصَّلاَةَ لِوَقْتِهَا إِلاَّ بِجَمْعٍ وَعَرَفَاتٍ

h2_title_en: Raising The Hands In Supplicant At 'Arfat
h2_title: باب رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ فِي الدُّعَاءِ بِعَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm > Hushaym > ʿAbd al-Malik > ʿAṭāʾ
body_en: I was a companion rider with the Prophet at Arafat. He raised his hands in supplication, so his she-camel began leaning and he dropped her halter, so he took the halter with one of his hands while he was raising the other hand.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ هُشَيْمٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ قَالَ
body: أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ كُنْتُ رَدِيفَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بِعَرَفَاتٍ فَرَفَعَ يَدَيْهِ يَدْعُو فَمَالَتْ بِهِ نَاقَتُهُ فَسَقَطَ خِطَامُهَا فَتَنَاوَلَ الْخِطَامَ بِإِحْدَى يَدَيْهِ وَهُوَ رَافِعٌ يَدَهُ الأُخْرَى

h2_title_en: Raising The Hands In Supplicant At 'Arfat
h2_title: باب رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ فِي الدُّعَاءِ بِعَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > Abū Muʿāwiyah > Hishām from his father > ʿĀʾishah
body_en: The Quraish used to stand in Al-Muzdalifah and they called themselves Al-Hums, and the rest of Arabs stood in Arafat. Then Allah, Blessed and Most High, commanded his Prophet to stand in Arafat, and then move on from there. Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, revealed: 'Then depart from the place whence all the people depart.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ
body: كَانَتْ قُرَيْشٌ تَقِفُ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ وَيُسَمَّوْنَ الْحُمْسَ وَسَائِرُ الْعَرَبِ تَقِفُ بِعَرَفَةَ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى نَبِيَّهُ ﷺ أَنْ يَقِفَ بِعَرَفَةَ ثُمَّ يَدْفَعُ مِنْهَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ﷻ { ثُمَّ أَفِيضُوا مِنْ حَيْثُ أَفَاضَ النَّاسُ }

h2_title_en: Raising The Hands In Supplicant At 'Arfat
h2_title: باب رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ فِي الدُّعَاءِ بِعَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah b. Saʿīd > Sufyān > ʿAmr b. Dīnār > Muḥammad b. Jubayr b. Muṭʿim from his father
body_en: I lost a camel of mine, so I went to look for it in Arafat on the day of Arafat. I saw the Prophet standing there and said: 'what is he doing here?' He is one of the Hums.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ
body: أَضْلَلْتُ بَعِيرًا لِي فَذَهَبْتُ أَطْلُبُهُ بِعَرَفَةَ يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ فَرَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَاقِفًا فَقُلْتُ مَا شَأْنُ هَذَا إِنَّمَا هَذَا مِنَ الْحُمْسِ

h2_title_en: Raising The Hands In Supplicant At 'Arfat
h2_title: باب رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ فِي الدُّعَاءِ بِعَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Sufyān > ʿAmr b. Dīnār > ʿAmr b. ʿAbdullāh b. Ṣafwān > Yazīd b. Shaybān
body_en: We were standing in Arafat in a place far from the place of standing, and Ibn Mirba Al-Ansari came and said: 'I am the messenger of Messenger of Allah to you; he says: 'Stay where you are (for it is a place of ritual), for you are following the legacy of you father Ibrahim, peace be upon him.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ أَنَّ يَزِيدَ بْنَ شَيْبَانَ قَالَ كُنَّا وُقُوفًا بِعَرَفَةَ مَكَانًا بَعِيدًا مِنَ الْمَوْقِفِ فَأَتَانَا ابْنُ مِرْبَعٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ فَقَالَ
body: إِنِّي رَسُولُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ إِلَيْكُمْ يَقُولُ كُونُوا عَلَى مَشَاعِرِكُمْ فَإِنَّكُمْ عَلَى إِرْثٍ مِنْ إِرْثِ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ

h2_title_en: Raising The Hands In Supplicant At 'Arfat
h2_title: باب رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ فِي الدُّعَاءِ بِعَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm > Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd > Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from my father > Ataynā Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh Fasaʾalnāh
body_en: My father told me: 'We came to Jabir bin ʿAbdullah and asked him about the Hajj of the Prophet. He told us that the Prophet said: "All of Arafat is the place of standing.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ أَتَيْنَا جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَسَأَلْنَاهُ
body: عَنْ حَجَّةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَحَدَّثَنَا أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ عَرَفَةُ كُلُّهَا مَوْقِفٌ

h2_title_en: The Obligation Of Standing In 'Arfat
title: null
chain_en: Isḥāq b. Ibrāhīm > Wakīʿ > Sufyān > Bukayr b. ʿAṭāʾ > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yaʿmar
body_en: I saw the Messenger of Allah when people came to him and asked him about Hajj. The Messenger of Allah said: 'Hajj is Arafat. Whoever catches up with the night of Arafat before dawn comes on the night of Jam (Al-Muzdalifah), his Hajj is complete.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا وَكِيعٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَعْمَرَ قَالَ
body: شَهِدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَأَتَاهُ نَاسٌ فَسَأَلُوهُ عَنِ الْحَجِّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْحَجُّ عَرَفَةُ فَمَنْ أَدْرَكَ لَيْلَةَ عَرَفَةَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ مِنْ لَيْلَةِ جَمْعٍ فَقَدْ تَمَّ حَجُّهُ

h2_title_en: The Obligation Of Standing In 'Arfat
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Ḥātim > Ḥibbān > ʿAbdullāh > ʿAbd al-Malik b. Abū Sulaymān > ʿAṭāʾ > Ibn ʿAbbās > al-Faḍl b. ʿAbbās
body_en: The Messenger of Allah departed from Arafat and Usmah bin Zaid rode behind him. His camel bolted and he was raising his hands (to rein it in) but not above his head. He carried on like that until he reached Jam (Al-Muzdalifah).
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حِبَّانُ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: أَفَاضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ عَرَفَاتٍ وَرِدْفُهُ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ فَجَالَتْ بِهِ النَّاقَةُ وَهُوَ رَافِعٌ يَدَيْهِ لاَ تُجَاوِزَانِ رَأْسَهُ فَمَا زَالَ يَسِيرُ عَلَى هِينَتِهِ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى جَمْعٍ

h2_title_en: The Obligation Of Standing In 'Arfat
title: null
chain_en: Ibrāhīm b. Yūnus b. Muḥammad from my father > Ḥammād > Qays b. Saʿd > ʿAṭāʾ > Ibn ʿAbbās > Usāmah b. Zayd
body_en: The Messneger of Allah departed from Arafat and I was riding behind him. He started trying to rein in his camel until its ears nearly touched the front of the saddle, and he was saying: 'O people, you must be tranquil and dignified, for righteousness does not come by making camels hurry.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُونُسَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ قَالَ
body: أَفَاضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ وَأَنَا رَدِيفُهُ فَجَعَلَ يَكْبَحُ رَاحِلَتَهُ حَتَّى أَنَّ ذِفْرَاهَا لَيَكَادُ يُصِيبُ قَادِمَةَ الرَّحْلِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالسَّكِينَةِ وَالْوَقَارِ فَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ لَيْسَ فِي إِيضَاعِ الإِبِلِ

h2_title_en: The Command To Be Tranquil When Departing From 'Arafat
h2_title: باب الأَمْرِ بِالسَّكِينَةِ فِي الإِفَاضَةِ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. ʿAlī b. Ḥarb > Muḥriz b. al-Waḍḍāḥ > Ismāʿīl / Ibn Umayyah > Abū Ghaṭafān b. Ṭarīf > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: When the Messenger of Allah departed he reined in his she-camel until its head touched the middle of his saddle, and he was saying to the people: 'Be tranquil be tranquil,' on the evening of Arafat.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَرْبٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحْرِزُ بْنُ الْوَضَّاحِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أُمَيَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي غَطَفَانَ بْنِ طَرِيفٍ حَدَّثَهُ
body: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ لَمَّا دَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ شَنَقَ نَاقَتَهُ حَتَّى أَنَّ رَأْسَهَا لَيَمَسُّ وَاسِطَةَ رَحْلِهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ لِلنَّاسِ السَّكِينَةَ السَّكِينَةَ عَشِيَّةَ عَرَفَةَ

h2_title_en: The Command To Be Tranquil When Departing From 'Arafat
h2_title: باب الأَمْرِ بِالسَّكِينَةِ فِي الإِفَاضَةِ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > al-Layth > Abū al-Zubayr > Abū Maʿbad a freed slave of Ibn ʿAbbās > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: on the eveing of Arafat and on the morning of Jam (Al-Muzdalifah), when they departed, the Messenger of Allah said to the people: "You must be tranquil," and was reining in his she-came. Then, when he was in Muhassir, which is part of Mina, he said: "You have to look for pebbles the size of date stones of fingertips," with which to stone the Jamrat. And the Messenger of Allah continued to recite the Talbiyah until he stoned Jamrat Al-Aqabah.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ أَبِي مَعْبَدٍ مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ
body: عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَكَانَ رَدِيفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ فِي عَشِيَّةِ عَرَفَةَ وَغَدَاةِ جَمْعٍ لِلنَّاسِ حِينَ دَفَعُوا عَلَيْكُمُ السَّكِينَةَ وَهُوَ كَافٌّ نَاقَتَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا دَخَلَ مُحَسِّرًا وَهُوَ مِنْ مِنًى قَالَ عَلَيْكُمْ بِحَصَى الْخَذْفِ الَّذِي يُرْمَى بِهِ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يُلَبِّي حَتَّى رَمَى الْجَمْرَةَ

h2_title_en: The Command To Be Tranquil When Departing From 'Arafat
h2_title: باب الأَمْرِ بِالسَّكِينَةِ فِي الإِفَاضَةِ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ

body_en:
The Messenger of Allah departed (From Arafat) in a tranquil manner, and he enjoined them to be tranquil. He hurried in the valley of Muhassir and told them to stone the Jamrat with (pebbles like date stones or fingertips. h2_title_en: Stopping After Moving On From 'Arafat
h2_title: باب النُّزُولِ بَعْدَ الدَّفْعِ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Qutaybah > Ḥammād > Ibrāhīm b. ʿUqbah > Kurayb > Usāmah b. Zayd
body_en: Are you going to pray Magrib?" He said: "The prayer place is still ahead of you.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ حَيْثُ أَفَاضَ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ مَالَ إِلَى الشِّعْبِ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَتُصَلِّي الْمَغْرِبَ قَالَ الْمُصَلَّى أَمَامَكَ

h2_title_en: Stopping After Moving On From 'Arafat
h2_title: باب النُّزُولِ بَعْدَ الدَّفْعِ مِنْ عَرَفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Maḥmūd b. Ghaylān > Wakīʿ > Sufyān > Ibrāhīm b. ʿUqbah > Kurayb > Usāmah b. Zayd
body_en: The Messenger of allah stopped in the mountain pass where the rulers stop now, and urinated, then he performed a light Wudu and I said: 'O Messenger of Allah (isit time for ) prayer?' He said: 'The prayer is still ahead of you.' When we came to Al-Muzdalifah the people did not unload their camles until he had prayed.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ نَزَلَ الشِّعْبَ الَّذِي يَنْزِلُهُ الأُمَرَاءُ فَبَالَ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ وُضُوءًا خَفِيفًا فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الصَّلاَةَ قَالَ الصَّلاَةُ أَمَامَكَ فَلَمَّا أَتَيْنَا الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ لَمْ يَحُلَّ آخِرُ النَّاسِ حَتَّى صَلَّى

h2_title_en: Joining Two Prayers In Al-Muzdalifah
title: null
chain_en: Yaḥyá b. Ḥabīb b. ʿArabī > Ḥammād > Yaḥyá > ʿAdī b. Thābit > ʿAbdullāh b. Yazīd > Abū Ayyūb
body_en: the Messenger of Allah joined Maghrib and Isha in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah).
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبِ بْنِ عَرَبِيٍّ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِجَمْعٍ

h2_title_en: Joining Two Prayers In Al-Muzdalifah
title: null
chain_en: al-Qāsim b. Zakariyyā > Muṣʿab b. al-Miqdām > Dāwud > al-Aʿmash > ʿUmārah > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd > Ibn Masʿūd
body_en: the Prophet joined Maghrib and Isha in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah).
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُصْعَبُ بْنُ الْمِقْدَامِ عَنْ دَاوُدَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ عَنْ عُمَارَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِجَمْعٍ

h2_title_en: Joining Two Prayers In Al-Muzdalifah
title: null
chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿAlī > Yaḥyá > Ibn Abū Dhiʾb > al-Zuhrī > Sālim from his father
body_en: the Messenger of Allah joined Maghrib and Isha; in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah), with one Iqamah, and he did not offer any voluntary prayers in between or after either of them.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
body: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ جَمَعَ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ بِجَمْعٍ بِإِقَامَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ لَمْ يُسَبِّحْ بَيْنَهُمَا وَلاَ عَلَى إِثْرِ كُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْهُمَا

h2_title_en: Joining Two Prayers In Al-Muzdalifah

The Messenger of Allah joined Maghrib and Isha with no (Voluntary) prayer in between them. He prayed Maghrib with three Rakahs and Isha with two." h2_title_en: Joining Two Prayers In Al-Muzdalifah
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Ḥātim > Ḥibbān > ʿAbdullāh > Ibrāhīm b. ʿUqbah > Kurayb
body_en: I asked usamah bin Zaid, who rode behind the Messenger of Allah one the evening of Arafat. I said: "What did you do?' He said: 'We started traveling until we reached Al-Muzadalifah, then he stopped and prayed Maghrib. Then he sent word to the people to stay in their camps, and they did not unload their camels until the Messenger of Allah had prayed the later Isah. Then the people unloaded their camels and made camp. When morning came I set out on foot amonth those of the Quraish who got there first, and Al-Fadl rode behind the Prophet.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا حِبَّانُ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ أَنَّ كُرَيْبًا قَالَ
body: سَأَلْتُ أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ وَكَانَ رِدْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ عَشِيَّةَ عَرَفَةَ فَقُلْتُ كَيْفَ فَعَلْتُمْ قَالَ أَقْبَلْنَا نَسِيرُ حَتَّى بَلَغْنَا الْمُزْدَلِفَةَ فَأَنَاخَ فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ بَعَثَ إِلَى الْقَوْمِ فَأَنَاخُوا فِي مَنَازِلِهِمْ فَلَمْ يَحِلُّوا حَتَّى صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ الْعِشَاءَ الآخِرَةَ ثُمَّ حَلَّ النَّاسُ فَنَزَلُوا فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحْنَا انْطَلَقْتُ عَلَى رِجْلِي فِي سُبَّاقِ قُرَيْشٍ وَرَدِفَهُ الْفَضْلُ

h2_title_en: Sending The Women And Children Ahead To The Camping Places In Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب تَقْدِيمِ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ إِلَى مَنَازِلِهِمْ بِمُزْدَلِفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: al-Ḥusayn b. Ḥurayth > Sufyān > ʿUbaydullāh b. Abū Yazīd > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: I heard Ibn Abbas say: I was one of those whom the Prophet sent ahead amongh the weak ones of his family.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ حُرَيْثٍ قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ قَالَ
body: سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ أَنَا مِمَّنْ قَدَّمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لَيْلَةَ الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ فِي ضَعَفَةِ أَهْلِهِ

h2_title_en: Sending The Women And Children Ahead To The Camping Places In Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب تَقْدِيمِ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ إِلَى مَنَازِلِهِمْ بِمُزْدَلِفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Muḥammad b. Manṣūr > Sufyān > ʿAmr > ʿAṭāʾ > Ibn ʿAbbās
body_en: I was one those whom the Prophet sent ahead on the night of Al-Muzdalifah among the weak ones of his family.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ
body: كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ قَدَّمَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ لَيْلَةَ الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ فِي ضَعَفَةِ أَهْلِهِ

h2_title_en: Sending The Women And Children Ahead To The Camping Places In Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب تَقْدِيمِ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ إِلَى مَنَازِلِهِمْ بِمُزْدَلِفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: Abū Dāwud > Abū ʿĀṣim And ʿAffān Wasulaymān > Shuʿbah > Mushāsh > ʿAṭāʾ > Ibn ʿAbbās > al-Faḍl
body_en: the Prophet commanded the weak ones among Banu Hashim to move on from Jam' (Al-Muzadalifah) at night.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ وَعَفَّانُ وَسُلَيْمَانُ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ مُشَاشٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَمَرَ ضَعَفَةَ بَنِي هَاشِمٍ أَنْ يَنْفِرُوا مِنْ جَمْعٍ بِلَيْلٍ

h2_title_en: Sending The Women And Children Ahead To The Camping Places In Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب تَقْدِيمِ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ إِلَى مَنَازِلِهِمْ بِمُزْدَلِفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿAlī > Yaḥyá > Ibn Jurayj > ʿAṭāʾ > Sālim b. Shawwāl > Um Ḥabībah
body_en: Umm Habibah told him that the Prophet told her to leave Jam (Al-Muzdalifah) for Mina at the end of the night.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءٌ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ شَوَّالٍ أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ
body: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ أَمَرَهَا أَنْ تُغَلِّسَ مِنْ جَمْعٍ إِلَى مِنًى

h2_title_en: Sending The Women And Children Ahead To The Camping Places In Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب تَقْدِيمِ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ إِلَى مَنَازِلِهِمْ بِمُزْدَلِفَةَ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAbd al-Jabbār b. al-ʿAlāʾ > Sufyān > ʿAmr > Sālim b. Shawwāl > Um Ḥabībah
body_en: We used to leave Jam Al-Muzdalifah for Mina at the end of the night, during the time of the Messenger of Allah.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَمْرٍو عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ شَوَّالٍ عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ قَالَتْ
body: كُنَّا نُغَلِّسُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ مِنَ الْمُزْدَلِفَةِ إِلَى مِنًى

Whoever does not catuch up with the people and the Imam, then has not caught it (Hajj).'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُدَامَةَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي جَرِيرٌ عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّسٍ قَالَ
body: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ جَمْعًا مَعَ الإِمَامِ وَالنَّاسِ حَتَّى يُفِيضَ مِنْهَا فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الْحَجَّ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُدْرِكْ مَعَ النَّاسِ وَالإِمَامِ فَلَمْ يُدْرِكْ

h2_title_en: Regarding One Who Does Not Catch Subh With The Imam In Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب فِيمَنْ لَمْ يُدْرِكْ صَلاَةَ الصُّبْحِ مَعَ الإِمَامِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn > Umayyah > Shuʿbah > Sayyār > al-Shaʿbī > ʿUrwah b. Muḍarris
body_en: I came to the Prohet in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah) and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, I have come from the two mountains of Tai and I did not leave any mountain but I stood on it; is there Hajj for me?' The Messenger of Allah said: 'Whoever offers this prayer with us, and stood before that in Arafatat by night or by day, his Hajj is complete, and he has completed the prescribed duties.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ سَيَّارٍ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّسٍ قَالَ
body: أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ بِجَمْعٍ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أَقْبَلْتُ مِنْ جَبَلَىْ طَيِّئٍ لَمْ أَدَعْ حَبْلاً إِلاَّ وَقَفْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَهَلْ لِي مِنْ حَجٍّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ مَنْ صَلَّى هَذِهِ الصَّلاَةَ مَعَنَا وَقَدْ وَقَفَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ بِعَرَفَةَ لَيْلاً أَوْ نَهَارًا فَقَدْ تَمَّ حَجُّهُ وَقَضَى تَفَثَهُ

h2_title_en: Regarding One Who Does Not Catch Subh With The Imam In Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب فِيمَنْ لَمْ يُدْرِكْ صَلاَةَ الصُّبْحِ مَعَ الإِمَامِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Ismāʿīl b. Masʿūd > Khālid > Shuʿbah > ʿAbdullāh b. Abū al-Safar > al-Shaʿbī > ʿUrwah b. Muḍarris b. Aws b. Ḥārithah b. Lʾm
body_en: I came to the Prophet in Jam (Al-Muzdalifah) and said: 'Is there Hajj for me?' He said: 'Whoever offers this prayer with us and observed this standing until he departed, and he departed before that from Arafat by night or by day, then his Hajj is complete. And he has completed the prescribed duties.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ مُضَرِّسِ بْنِ أَوْسِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ لأْمٍ قَالَ
body: أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ بِجَمْعٍ فَقُلْتُ هَلْ لِي مِنْ حَجٍّ فَقَالَ مَنْ صَلَّى هَذِهِ الصَّلاَةَ مَعَنَا وَوَقَفَ هَذَا الْمَوْقِفَ حَتَّى يُفِيضَ وَأَفَاضَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ عَرَفَاتٍ لَيْلاً أَوْ نَهَارًا فَقَدْ تَمَّ حَجُّهُ وَقَضَى تَفَثَهُ

h2_title_en: Regarding One Who Does Not Catch Subh With The Imam In Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب فِيمَنْ لَمْ يُدْرِكْ صَلاَةَ الصُّبْحِ مَعَ الإِمَامِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿAlī > Yaḥyá > Ismāʿīl > ʿĀmir > ʿUrwah b. Muḍarris al-Ṭāʾī
body_en: I came to the Messenger of Allah and said: "I have come to you from the two mountains of Tai and I have exhausted my camel, and exhausted myself; is there Hajj for me?' He said: 'Whoever offeres this morning prayer with us here, and came to Arafat before that, then he has completed the prescribed duties and his Hajj is complete.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرٌ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ مُضَرِّسٍ الطَّائِيُّ قَالَ
body: أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَقُلْتُ أَتَيْتُكَ مِنْ جَبَلَىْ طَيِّئٍ أَكْلَلْتُ مَطِيَّتِي وَأَتْعَبْتُ نَفْسِي مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ حَبْلٍ إِلاَّ وَقَفْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَهَلْ لِي مِنْ حَجٍّ فَقَالَ مَنْ صَلَّى صَلاَةَ الْغَدَاةِ هَا هُنَا مَعَنَا وَقَدْ أَتَى عَرَفَةَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ قَضَى تَفَثَهُ وَتَمَّ حَجُّهُ

h2_title_en: Regarding One Who Does Not Catch Subh With The Imam In Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب فِيمَنْ لَمْ يُدْرِكْ صَلاَةَ الصُّبْحِ مَعَ الإِمَامِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
title: null
chain_en: ʿAmr b. ʿAlī > Yaḥyá > Sufyān > Bukayr b. ʿAṭāʾ > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yaʿmar al-Dīlī
body_en: I saw the prophet in Arafat when some people from Najd coame to him. They told a man to ask him about Hajj. He said: "Hajj is Arafat. Whoever comes on the night of Jam (Al-Muzdalifah) before Subh prayer, then he has caought up with Hajj. And the days of Mina are three days. But whoever hastens to leave in two days, there is no sion on him, and whoever stays on, there is no sino on him.' Then he made a man ride behind him, and he started proclaiming it to the people.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بُكَيْرُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ يَعْمَرَ الدِّيلِيَّ قَالَ
body: شَهِدْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ بِعَرَفَةَ وَأَتَاهُ نَاسٌ مِنْ نَجْدٍ فَأَمَرُوا رَجُلاً فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ الْحَجِّ فَقَالَ الْحَجُّ عَرَفَةُ مَنْ جَاءَ لَيْلَةَ جَمْعٍ قَبْلَ صَلاَةِ الصُّبْحِ فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ حَجَّهُ أَيَّامُ مِنًى ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ { مَنْ تَعَجَّلَ فِي يَوْمَيْنِ فَلاَ إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ وَمَنْ تَأَخَّرَ فَلاَ إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ } ثُمَّ أَرْدَفَ رَجُلاً فَجَعَلَ يُنَادِي بِهَا فِي النَّاسِ

h2_title_en: Regarding One Who Does Not Catch Subh With The Imam In Al-Muzdalifah
h2_title: باب فِيمَنْ لَمْ يُدْرِكْ صَلاَةَ الصُّبْحِ مَعَ الإِمَامِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
title: null
chain_en: Yaʿqūb b. Ibrāhīm > Yaḥyá b. Saʿīd > Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad from my father > Ataynā Jābir b. ʿAbdullāh
body_en: We came to Jabir bin Abdullah and he told us that the Messenger of Allah said: 'All of Al Muzdalifah is a place for (the pilgrims) to stand.'
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ أَتَيْنَا جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
body: فَحَدَّثَنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ الْمُزْدَلِفَةُ كُلُّهَا مَوْقِفٌ

h2_title_en: The Talbiyah In Al-Muzdalifah
title: null
chain_en: Hannād b. al-Sarī Fī Ḥadīthih > Abū al-Aḥwaṣ > Ḥuṣayn > Kathīr And Hū Ibn Mudrik > ʿAbd al-Raḥman b. Yazīd > Ibn Masʿūd Wanaḥn Bijamʿ
body_en: When we were in Jam (Al-Muzadalifah), Ibn Masud said: 'I heard the one to whoem surat Al-Baqarah was revealed say, in this place: Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik.
chain: أَخْبَرَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ فِي حَدِيثِهِ عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ عَنْ كَثِيرٍ وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُدْرِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ وَنَحْنُ بِجَمْعٍ
body: سَمِعْتُ الَّذِي أُنْزِلَتْ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةُ الْبَقَرَةِ يَقُولُ فِي هَذَا الْمَكَانِ لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ

body_en:
I head him say 'I saw 'Umar in Al-Muzdalifah and he said: The people of the Jahiliyyah would not depart until the sun had risen, and they would say: Shine, O Thabir!
